Medicine Online E540 -用藥學問 / 杏林在線 第540集 - 用藥學問
programme.desc: 藥物過敏嚴重可致命，有人忽然過敏，有人反而中途沒有敏感，過敏狀況為何隨時間改變? 旅行前配備平安藥及外遊購藥，有何要注意?今集《杏林在線》，心胸外科護士Charmaine從小沒有任何過敏問題，近年服用抗生素盤尼西林後，卻突然嚴重藥物過敏，導致皮膚起疹及過敏性休克，更要調離原本的工作崗位。小時候沒有對某種藥物過敏，長大後竟然忽然過敏？免疫及過敏科醫生說，這個情況的確會發生。港大臨床醫學學院內科學系臨床副教授李曦：「坦白地說，醫生也不是那麼清楚為甚麼這個病人，在這個時候會過敏。我們相信免疫系統，年紀大了會慢慢轉變，有時它在那一刻誤會了那個藥物是有害。如果那些藥物，不是經常適當時使用，處方次數更加多，好像會增加將來藥物過敏的機會。」相反有些人小時候診斷有過敏，到年紀大一點，反而有機會痊癒，節目內醫生會講解原因。外地藥妝店也有成藥出售，但部分成藥有機會含未經本港註冊成分，萬一不當服用成分和劑量，出現藥物過敏或相沖，本地醫護人員很難作後續跟進治療。醫護行者藥劑服務經理陳彥廷：「當然有些成分是相通的，有些成分可能在香港並沒有註冊。有時實際上，是我們不懂那個語言，其實我們也不知道藥物裡的有效成分是甚麼，是否適合那個人去服用。」註冊藥劑師亦會講解，藥盒分裝和切藥的注意事項。

Now Forum E1022 -嘉賓：衞炳江(浸會大學校長) / 題目：北都大學城與浸大發展 / 大鳴大放 第1022集 - 嘉賓：衞炳江(浸會大學校長) / 題目：北都大學城與浸大發展
programme.desc: 北都規劃三個大學城，包括新田、打鼓嶺和洪水橋。浸會大學校長衞炳江接受《大鳴大放》專訪時表示，浸大會率先考慮新田大學城，他指出河套香港園區的發展已相當成熟，他得知明年年中的樓宇興建完成，計劃將現時在科學園的部份實驗室搬入新田河套。至於洪水橋大學城，他則表示考慮中，因對學校財政構成較大壓力。洪水橋大學城用地政府預留100億元貸款供院校建校舍，衛炳江直指不足。他以浸大何善衡校園重建一半校園為例，指出因政府的財政問題現已停工：「香港起樓好貴，由我五年前入浸大，何善衡舊校園幾幢樓，由二十幾億變成現在三十幾億了。那是幾幢樓而已，所以你一百億，不是只給一家學校，是全部人一起申請，所以可以拿到的錢不會多，而政府的配對一對一，那都是二百億而已，不是興建到很多東西。」衞炳江表示浸大計劃先進駐新田大學城：「我們在想短期的新田，長期的打鼓嶺。」他續指新田河套香港園區主力做生物科技，浸大準備整合九龍塘校園及沙田科學園內的浸大實驗室，會將部份實驗室搬進河套。衞炳江指浸大計劃在新田做體育科技、文化科技等不同的新技項目。至於籌募相關經費上，發債是校方考慮的一個方向：「就算我不建樓，搬實驗室、擴建、買儀器等都會需要錢，這方面學校是積極考慮發債的。」另外，衞炳江指出八大之中，浸大校舍最小，空間問題影響學校的長遠發展，他希望能將浸大搬入北都：「我們是需要一個更加多的地方，我不同意做分校，你分開兩三個地方之後，是沒有協同效應，最理想就是一個更大的統一的校園，而北都地方大，我希望做到宿舍是四年四宿，住宿舍是大學教育的重要一部分。」

programme.desc: 政府九月公布的《五年規劃》，為香港未來五年籌劃發展藍圖，當中提到要優化現時的經濟結構。面對科技急速發展，社交平台普及，市場變化萬千，產業要轉型發展的任務艱鉅。有百年老字號酒樓，疫情期間一度結業，後來有公司買入品牌使用權，使酒樓得以「重生」。老闆黃熙仁認為，品牌的百年歷史是一個賣點，不過面對不少酒樓結業，以及港人北上消費，逆市下接手經營，他們決定既保留飲茶傳統，包括點心推車、人手寫點心卡等，同時亦加入新元素。除了早前推出飲早茶看世界盃賽事，酒樓現在每個月會舉行懷舊金曲夜，讓客人可以邊吃點心、邊聽歌跳舞。黃熙仁說經營傳統餐飲不能只保有傳統，更要跟上潮流，讓不同年齡層的客人都想來光顧，才能生存下去。在網絡普及生態下，市場變化更快，有開業超過二十年的本地時裝品牌認為，要不斷轉型，才可站穩陣腳。創辦人陳志山有一個理念，要每天都有一個新設計，讓客人不停有新鮮感，不能原地踏步。為了讓設計及生產更有彈性，他們保留在疫情期間於香港設立的生產線，視之為一個「廚房」，讓設計師可以隨時更改服裝設計，也可少量生產，加快製作流程，提升新款式推出的頻率。《五年規劃》提及發展新型工業，有學者認為在科技協助下，新型工業不是以往工人多的量產方式，而是以智能化提升生產流程，協助傳統產業轉為智能化生產，有條件成為經濟增長的新引擎。有開業七十多年的鋼鐵公司，眼見工人老化，五年前開始引入機械臂，就如打電動般進行燒焊，代替以往由工人焊接工序，成功讓工人的平均年齡，由五十多歲降至三十多歲，亦減省加工時間及成本。現時工序幾乎百分百機械化，行政總裁黎鍔威表示，老牌公司要轉型並不容易，但同時相信，不轉型就只會被淘汰。

programme.title: Holidays For The Animals E6 -碧武里大象之巨大化任務 / 毛國界義工假期 第6集 - 碧武里大象之巨大化任務
programme.desc: 轉戰泰國碧武里，到訪東南亞最大型野生動物救援中心。照顧大象初體驗，所有任務瞬間「巨大化」！準備 200公斤的食物，劈開比人更高的象草，力氣稍弱都應付不了。

programme.title: Wish you good health E143 -生蛇 / 我想身體健康 第143集 - 生蛇
programme.desc: 生蛇聽得多，假如蛇生上眼，究竟會怎樣？今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，找來阿Gi一起請教醫生！不幸生蛇上眼，患者應如何應對？

programme.title: The Popcorn Show 4 E22 -粵劇《粵劇特朗普》 - 嘉賓：李居明、龍貫天、陳鴻進 / 爆谷一周 第22集 - 粵劇《粵劇特朗普》 - 嘉賓：李居明、龍貫天、陳鴻進
programme.desc: 李居明大師主創荒誕粵劇——《粵劇特朗普 6.0》馬上公演！今次「十柱聯演」、更將機械人搬上傳統舞台！劇中靈魂人物龍貫天、陳鴻進反串一眾惡搞角色，延續一貫「匪夷所思」！模仿各國政壇風雲人物，真的全無底線？時事粵劇會否跟車太貼？當傳統碰上AI時代，戲曲傳統如何守？究竟「粵劇特朗普」怎樣「得到好分數」？

programme.title: FWD Presents: CHILL CLUB E328 -嘉賓: Ryan 蔡俊彥 / CHILL CLUB 第328集 - 嘉賓: Ryan 蔡俊彥
programme.desc: 本集《CHILL CLUB》請來 Ryan 蔡俊彥，今集主題是「Positive」。Ryan 以歌曲帶出不同的情緒，由討厭、失落、受傷到感情中的混亂，原來 Positive 並不代表每一刻都要開心，而是學會從不同角度看待自己的感受。此外，節目亦設有「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，與樂迷一同公布本週第一至第十位推介歌曲。

programme.title: Crayon Shinchan E273 / 蠟筆小新 第273集
programme.desc: 臼井儀人漫畫作品。五歲小孩野原新之助（小新）百厭趣怪，個性誇張自戀，是最令人頭痛的小朋友。小新與父親廣志、母親美冴、妹妹小葵住在埼玉縣的春日部市，最愛領著「雙葉幼稚園」的朋友你搞冒險，在日常生活中製造無數瘋狂趣事。

programme.title: SPY×FAMILY Season 3 E40 -■■■■的記憶Ⅱ / SPY×FAMILY間諜家家酒 第三季 第40集 - ■■■■的記憶Ⅱ
programme.desc: 醒來時，因空襲而殘破不堪的街道，早已化為戰場。就這樣，■■■■與家人失散。而後他成長為青年並投身軍隊，日復一日手握步槍立於戰場。然而某個夜晚，他遇見了來自東人民共和國的士兵——弗朗基…

programme.title: Be An Acting Star E5 -灰姑娘 / 選角 第5集 - 灰姑娘
programme.desc: 今集揭曉《西遊記》對決的賽果後，最後一場小組對決亦隨之展開。兩組的題目為《灰姑娘》，一組忠於原著，另一組創新改編。兩組的精彩演出均令觀眾及評審叫好，結果其中一組只以兩分之微落敗…

programme.title: Priceless Meal E5 -蒜頭婆婆 / 買不到的一餐 第5集 - 蒜頭婆婆
programme.desc: 認知障礙的患者會慢慢失去記憶，一對兄妹看著嫲嫲患病的情況，決定肩負起照顧她的責任，更與她一起創立「蒜頭婆」，讓更多人知道認知障礙患者的需要。

programme.title: Force of Love E7 -是蠢還是很偉大 (I) / 大力情人 第7集 - 是蠢還是很偉大 (I)
programme.desc: 今集《大力情人》再次由室內轉戰室外！烈日當空，四對情侶將會迎來一場長時間的挑戰，面對崎嶇不平的山路，究竟哪一對情侶能夠找到平衡，刷新記錄呢？

programme.title: Pay less, Play more S2 E10 -大阪府 / 日本winwin企画 S2 第10集 - 大阪府
programme.desc: 在不少遊客眼中，大阪只是京阪神旅程的配角，除了環球影城跟商場就沒什麼可逛。這次Win Win走出為人熟悉的市區，來到大阪府的各個地方，發掘有趣的玩樂點。

programme.title: Never Dive Alone E12 -挑戰「自由潛水」 / 潛在挑戰中 第12集 - 挑戰「自由潛水」
programme.desc: 四位潛水員得悉日本潛水旅程需接受個人挑戰後，紛紛神色凝重，而挑戰失敗將需接受神秘懲罰。而第一個潛水挑戰是「自由潛水」，在沒有氣瓶及其他潛水裝備的輔助下，只吸一口氣潛入大海，一項危險度更高的潛水運動。導師更請來自由潛水世界記錄保持者廣瀨花子，今日的挑戰者會在水溫冰凍及海浪洶湧的情況下落水，到底潛水員能否完成節目組的指定挑戰？

programme.title: MM730 - Beast fight game E27 -蛇梯棋盤 (II) / MM730 - 困獸鬥 第27集 - 蛇梯棋盤 (II)
programme.desc: 繼上集連番激戰後，6位困獸勇士依然被困於蛇梯棋戰場。各人除了墮入進進退退的輪迴外，更被各項附加指令胡攪蠻纏，處於崩潰邊緣。但此戰役需要有兩位勇士過關才能結束，到底哪兩位才是拯救眾人於水深火熱的英雄呢？

programme.title: Green Finder E79 -校服重造 (I) / 環保發現號 第79集 - 校服重造 (I)
programme.desc: 如果要棄置一件舊衣，除了捐去回收箱，還能如何賦予它第二次生命？今集一起聽聽嘉賓如何發揮創意，製造不同的環保創意產品。

programme.title: Sound and Vision S9 E12 -無聲告白 / 聲畫合拍 9 第12集 - 無聲告白
programme.desc: 《無聲告白》講述主角Fay因長期溝通失效而患上心因性失聲，自此她習慣以沉默去面對世界。然而，當Fay目睹新人同事Cody遭受惡意陷害時，她開始陷入掙扎⋯⋯今集請來導演和 歌手上來分享拍攝故事。

programme.title: GYM Room Stories E9 -女性專屬 / 10個尖房故事 第9集 - 女性專屬
programme.desc: 女性專屬的尖房近年應運而生，究竟是怎樣一片天地：是避開異性專注操練的清淨地？針對女性獨特需要的專門户？還是花枝招展爭妍鬥麗的姊妹墟？今集主持及嘉賓Kiri T會打開一道女性專屬尖房的粉紅色大門，裡面更有一位世界級冠軍人馬的女健身教練，講一個「女兒當自強」的故事。

programme.desc: 圈網球在香港仍是一項相對新興的小眾運動。它結合了排球的傳接技巧與快速反應，講求速度、默契與精準控制。而在這群熱愛這項運動的人當中，有一位特別的身影—Sano。Sano的正職是廣播工程人員，廣播工程與圈網球看似截然不同，卻同樣需要高度專注與精準判斷。

programme.desc: 楊小芳是一位專注於裝置及行為藝術的藝術家，畢業於香港藝術學院，主修繪畫。因九歲時因事故失去雙臂，她透過不斷的身體練習，將身體作為創作媒介，以探索存在的意義。小芳創作超過十年，涵蓋繪畫、陶瓷、錄像及聲音藝術，並積極從事藝術教育與演講。她的作品旨在反映自己身體的經歷及體驗，並致力於提升社會對殘疾人士的理解，現與好友合作推動「殘疾藝術駐留」計劃(Crip Art Residency)，以促進社會對多樣性的接納。

programme.desc: 身為獨家記者也是知名時事電視節目主持人的徐靜媛因緣巧合下被懷疑成殺害丈夫薛雨宰的秘密情婦的兇手，為了擺脫這個污名與警察金太賢結盟，揭開謀殺案背後的真相。

programme.title: Good Partner (Bilingual) E11 / 好搭檔 第11集
programme.desc: 講述明星律師車恩京和新人律師之間冰冷而熾熱的法庭辦公室電視劇。描述了面對人生計劃中沒有的意外離別的人們、在解散家庭的瞬間發生的兩難境地。 在冷酷的人生平衡遊戲中，想要選最好的離婚律師們的故事。

programme.title: The Vendetta of An (Bilingual) E2 / 長安二十四計 第2集
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: The Vendetta of An (Bilingual) E4 / 長安二十四計 第4集
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E5 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第5集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman (Bilingual) E5 / 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們 第5集
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E5 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第5集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman (Bilingual) E5 / 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們 第5集
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: Canned Mackerel Heads to Space (Bilingual) E5 / 鯖魚罐頭，航向宇宙 第5集
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: Private Banker (Bilingual) E1 / 私人銀行家 第1集
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突。

programme.desc: 講述圍繞著一個女人殺人事件而展開兩個男人的激烈故事，從大眾視角去揭開刑事司法制度。

programme.title: High School Return of a Gangster (Bilingual) E7 / 黑幫的我成了高中生 第7集
programme.desc: 高中輟學的47歲黑幫成員，意外被困在自殺身亡的18歲男學生的體內。回到高中校園，憑藉黑幫技能向惡霸復仇，並與遭受家庭暴力的同學建立了友誼的故事。

programme.title: Nothing Uncovered (Bilingual) E22 / 抓住你的衣領 第22集

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: One Ordinary Day (Bilingual) E4 / 某一天 第4集
programme.desc: 講述圍繞著一個女人殺人事件而展開兩個男人的激烈故事，從大眾視角去揭開刑事司法制度。

programme.title: High School Return of a Gangster (Bilingual) E9 / 黑幫的我成了高中生 第9集
programme.desc: 高中輟學的47歲黑幫成員，意外被困在自殺身亡的18歲男學生的體內。回到高中校園，憑藉黑幫技能向惡霸復仇，並與遭受家庭暴力的同學建立了友誼的故事。

programme.title: Bitter Sweet Hell (Bilingual) E2 / 我們，家 第2集
programme.desc: 盧英媛是大韓民國公認最優秀的家庭心理諮詢醫生，與整形外科醫生丈夫崔宰鎮是所有人都羨慕的夫妻。但突然被不明來歷的神秘女人世娜所威脅，自己曾經令人艷羨的事業與家庭一切都被徹底動搖。為了守護所有家人，開始與作為推理小說作家的家婆洪思江合作守護家人。

programme.desc: 講述明星律師車恩京和新人律師之間冰冷而熾熱的法庭辦公室電視劇。描述了面對人生計劃中沒有的意外離別的人們、在解散家庭的瞬間發生的兩難境地。 在冷酷的人生平衡遊戲中，想要選最好的離婚律師們的故事。

programme.title: The Vendetta of An (Bilingual) E9 / 長安二十四計 第9集
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: Twilight E32 / 暮色心約 第32集
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: The Dark Romance E22 / 危險關係 第22集
programme.desc: 單親媽媽顏聆在調查閨蜜自殺真相的過程中，意外陷入「情緒操控（PUA）」陷阱，愛恨糾葛中，顏聆逐漸覺醒並最終重獲新生。

programme.title: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty E28 / 唐朝詭事錄 第28集
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E15 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第15集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: Unchained Love E19 / 浮圖緣 第19集
The Dark Romance E22 / 危險關係 第22集

programme.title: Twilight E32 / 暮色心約 第32集
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: Pledge of Allegiance E23 / 山河之影 第23集
programme.desc: 《山河之影》改編自路陽執導的同名系列電影《繡春刀》，講述兩位少年以赤子情懷協力衝破人生困境的江湖故事。 建文三年，雞鵝巷的小賊李霧濟南府金事王克恭攜萬貫家財平調進入南京城，便盜錦衣百戶李東方之名帖潛入王克恭府夢想著順利盜寶，在一夜之間坐擁菜華富貴。不料王克恭府中暗流湧動，李霧被迫捲入了一場圍繞魚瞑鎖展開的前朝火器之爭中，原本作為局外人的李霧成為了魚瞑鎖的持有者，陷入了漩渦中心。兒時，將李霧詔獄中解救的孩童宋真如今已成為錦衣衛陸錚，與李霧成了同僚，相見不相認；和李霧曾同處個囚室的女童舒棠變成了夜不收刺客，並跟李霧成了間諜夫妻，共同完成夜不收的任務。朝野紛爭的陰暗與殘酷讓三人之間的感情也在連環鎖樣的陰暗中經受著考驗。當改朝換代的那一刻到來的時候，所有的戰事和未解的迷局，都將落下帷幕。

programme.desc: 俞笑擁有一段令人外人羨慕的婚姻，然而因一起女高中生的遇害案，警察宋誠發現俞笑成了其與手頭一樁塵封舊案的共同證人，調查過程中，警方發現俞笑丈夫朱鶴好好男人的外表下，藏著無數與案件相關的線索。而對於俞笑而言，遇見宋誠和身份成謎的安妮後，她開始直面多年前的陰影……

programme.title: My Dearest Stranger E12 / 暗戀者的救贖 第12集
programme.desc: 俞笑擁有一段令人外人羨慕的婚姻，然而因一起女高中生的遇害案，警察宋誠發現俞笑成了其與手頭一樁塵封舊案的共同證人，調查過程中，警方發現俞笑丈夫朱鶴好好男人的外表下，藏著無數與案件相關的線索。而對於俞笑而言，遇見宋誠和身份成謎的安妮後，她開始直面多年前的陰影……

programme.title: Pledge of Allegiance E23 / 山河之影 第23集
programme.desc: 《山河之影》改編自路陽執導的同名系列電影《繡春刀》，講述兩位少年以赤子情懷協力衝破人生困境的江湖故事。 建文三年，雞鵝巷的小賊李霧濟南府金事王克恭攜萬貫家財平調進入南京城，便盜錦衣百戶李東方之名帖潛入王克恭府夢想著順利盜寶，在一夜之間坐擁菜華富貴。不料王克恭府中暗流湧動，李霧被迫捲入了一場圍繞魚瞑鎖展開的前朝火器之爭中，原本作為局外人的李霧成為了魚瞑鎖的持有者，陷入了漩渦中心。兒時，將李霧詔獄中解救的孩童宋真如今已成為錦衣衛陸錚，與李霧成了同僚，相見不相認；和李霧曾同處個囚室的女童舒棠變成了夜不收刺客，並跟李霧成了間諜夫妻，共同完成夜不收的任務。朝野紛爭的陰暗與殘酷讓三人之間的感情也在連環鎖樣的陰暗中經受著考驗。當改朝換代的那一刻到來的時候，所有的戰事和未解的迷局，都將落下帷幕。

programme.title: Eight Hundred E1 / 方圓八百米 第1集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: The Bionic Life E12 / 仿生人間 第12集
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫......

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 2 E1 / 唐人街探案2 第1集
programme.desc: 《唐人街探案2》中海外再發多起奇案，唐仁大弟子林默、天才黑客Kiko紛紛登場，更有眾多新偵探新人物亮相！為探尋真相，老偵探再集結重掀唐人街風雲！懸疑故事幽默風格深刻寓意，呈現探案新潮流。

programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: The Bionic Life E12 / 仿生人間 第12集
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫......

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 2 E1 / 唐人街探案2 第1集
programme.desc: 《唐人街探案2》中海外再發多起奇案，唐仁大弟子林默、天才黑客Kiko紛紛登場，更有眾多新偵探新人物亮相！為探尋真相，老偵探再集結重掀唐人街風雲！懸疑故事幽默風格深刻寓意，呈現探案新潮流。

programme.title: Royal Rumours E22 / 花琉璃軼聞 第22集
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: Royal Rumours E23 / 花琉璃軼聞 第23集
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: Twilight E33 / 暮色心約 第33集
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E1 / 問心 2 第1集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty E29 / 唐朝詭事錄 第29集
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E16 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第16集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E2 / 問心 2 第2集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty E30 / 唐朝詭事錄 第30集
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E17 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第17集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E3 / 問心 2 第3集

programme.title: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty E31 / 唐朝詭事錄 第31集
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E19 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第19集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.desc: 由張純燁、伊能靜、張繼科、朱正廷、宋雨琦、姜振宇等人組成的「戀愛觀察團」，8位年輕男女於雲南大理「浪漫滿屋」合宿一個月，開啟同一屋簷下的合租模式，並於其中彼此之間出現的信號進行推理愛情。

programme.title: Wildfire (Mini drama) E27 / 野火 (短劇) 第27集
programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭、內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義。

programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: Traditional Chinese Medicine Youth Chronicles Season 3 E6 -國醫少年團學健腎操 / 國醫少年志 第3季 第6集 - 國醫少年團學健腎操
programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深。

programme.title: Constantine / 康斯坦汀：驅魔神探
programme.desc: Globetrotting misfit and renegade occultist John Constantine helps a skeptical policewoman investigate the mysterious suicide of her twin sister.

programme.title: A Place In The Sun / 郎心如鐵
programme.desc: An ambitious young man becomes trapped between wealth, love and murder when pursuing a better life.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda / 功夫熊貓
programme.desc: Po is a dreamer who must embrace his true self in order to become the Dragon Warrior. Filled with high-kicking humor and an all-star cast.

programme.title: War And Peace / 戰爭與和平
programme.desc: Amid Napoleon's invasion of Russia, several aristocratic families navigate love, war and personal transformation.

programme.title: Shooter / 辣手槍
programme.desc: A former Marine sniper is framed for assassination and uses his skills to expose a deadly conspiracy.

programme.title: What if SHOGUN Ieyasu Tokugawa was to become the Prime Minister / 如果德川家康成為總理大臣
programme.desc: In the year of 2020, when Covid-19 is spreading rapidly around the world, a sudden virus outbreak in Japan leads to the death of the Prime Minister. This causes the Japanese government to put in place an unprecedented plan, which is to bring back the greatest leaders from Japanese history through AI holograms and form a super cabinet with them. These famous individuals include Tokugawa Ieyasu, Sakamoto Ryoma, Oda Nobunaga, and Toyotomi Hideyoshi. On the other hand, a TV reporter, Risa Nishimura, approaches the government spokesperson, Sakamoto Ryoma, for an exclusive scoop, in order to achieve her dream of becoming an announcer. As people start going crazy over this new legendary cabinet, Risa realizes that something is going on behind this cabinet...

programme.title: Mad Fate / 命案
programme.desc: On a rainy evening, a fortune telling master tries to help a prostitute avert certain death, but fate has plans of its own. He arrives at the prostitute's home just a few minutes too late, watching her take her last breath while Siu Tung stares at her corpse with creepy fascination. When he foretells that Siu Tung will soon commit murder, the Master believes that he has the power to change the inevitable. On the contrary, the veteran detective who once sent Siu Tung to jail for brutally killing a cat believes that Siu Tong is a born psychopath whose bloodthirst cannot be stopped. While Siu Tung becomes increasingly overwhelmed by his insatiable desire for murder, the Master puts his sanity on the line to change the course of fate. But is it possible to defeat the all-powerful force that paves life's path?

programme.title: The Rising Star -Tang Lai Ying / 我要做接班人 -鄧麗英
programme.desc: Tang Lai Ying, known as “All-bad-angles pretty girl”, played a club girl-wannabe waitress in the film “Night King” and her comedic performance has won the audience's favor. Despite her cheerful and optimistic personality both on and off screen, she has experienced confusion on her journey to pursue her dreams. Despite of the popularity of her comedic image, she also longs for audiences to see her serious side. In this programme, Lai Ying is going to share her philosophy on happiness, giving everyone a glimpse of her most authentic self.

programme.title: All Shall Be Well / 從今以後
programme.desc: Angie and Pat are a lesbian couple who have been together for over four decades. Pat bought an apartment over thirty years ago where they have lived ever since. The couple is open to their families and often invites Pat's family to their home for dinners. Angie's relationship with them has always been very close. When Pat passes away unexpectedly, Angie is suddenly left on her own to deal with matters related to Pat and her estate. It is not too long before a clash develops over their opinions about the burial arrangements. Angie begins to feel increasingly alienated from Pat's family...

programme.title: The Aroma City / 芳香之城傳奇
programme.desc: Princess Su of the magical Aroma City falls to earth and in love with Jiang. But as Jiang is no angel, there is an infernal contract out on his soul...

programme.title: Infernal Affairs III / 終極無間
programme.desc: Ten months after the murder of Yan (Tony Leung), Ming (Andy Lau) is relegated to the backseat of mundane office work, pending internal investigation. Exhausted mentally and physically, Ming is running on empty, but he is convinced that he can reverse his fortune in no time. Meanwhile, a new star has emerged in the police force. Hardly forty years old, Wing (Leon Lai) has already risen to the top echelon thanks to his illustrious track record...

programme.title: Hopeless / 黑道深淵
programme.desc: High school student Yeon-gyu lives in a nightmare, where he needs to endure the physical abuse from his alcoholic stepfather. His only goal is to save enough money and escape from the living hell with his mother. One day, he gets into a fight and receives help from Chi-geon, an enigmatic gangster in the town. While the relationship of the two gradually develops into a brotherhood, Chi-geon is getting deeper in the swamp.

programme.title: The Narrow Road / 窄路微塵
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: Men of Plastic / 肌智整容大叔
programme.desc: The most glamorous part of Seoul, Apgujeong thrives with new possibilities. Dae-guk who is a native of Apgujeong and rules its ground, is eager to start his own groundbreaking plastic surgery business. Then he encounters Ji-woo, the most talented surgeon in the area who lost his medical license due to someone sabotaging his reputation. Dae-guk effortlessly comes up with an idea to make this business happen, and he does everything he can to make Ji-woo his partner. Together, Dae-guk and Ji-woo open a whole new era of Apgujeong.

programme.title: Fagara / 花椒之味
programme.desc: After her father died, a Hong Kong girl discovers she has two hitherto unknown sisters, one in Taipei and one in Chongqing. To settle her father's debt, she must reunite with them to run the family's hot pot restaurant. While the androgynous Taipei sister is plagued by her toxic relationship with her mother, the fashionista sister from Chongqing is trying to fend off her grandmother's pressure to get married. Meanwhile, she is striving to unshackle herself from her ex-boyfriend in order to start a new relationship.

programme.title: Let’s Go Karaoke! / 唱K吧！黑道之哥
programme.desc: Yakuza member Narita is consumed by only one thing: how to survive his boss' annual karaoke competition. Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

programme.title: Atonement / 阿龍
programme.desc: Single father Lung and his daughter Ying are each other's only dependence. Despite the huge debt left by his ex-wife, Lung believes in good karma for good people, until he loses his beloved daughter in a kidnap while travelling in Thailand. Lung abandons all his faith. He marries a Thai Chinese, Lan, and starts a new life in Thailand. However, he never leaves the past behind. All these years he has been gathering information of the kidnap gang, and vows to take justice into his own hands at any cost...

programme.title: Director’s Premiere -Nick Cheuk / 初嚟報「導」 -卓亦謙
programme.desc: New director Nick Cheuk who won four awards with his debut feature ‘Time Still Turns The Pages', advanced from a screenwriter to a director and have accomplished his movie dream with passion. However, it was not an easy job working three roles at a time especially it was his first time directing. How did he overcome all kinds of challenges during the process? In this interview, Nick will share his unforgettable moments during filming and also talk about his movie beliefs.

programme.title: That Demon Within / 魔警
programme.desc: By a strange twist of fate, dutiful Hong Kong policeman Dave Wong saves the life of the leader of a violent gang of armed robbers. When they commit another crime, Dave is determined to put an end to their activities. He works with the leader, whom the gang had betrayed, to engineer a plan to wreak havoc within the gang and let the gangsters kill one another. But it becomes increasingly obvious to Dave and to his colleagues that Dave is suffering from a severe mental disorder, and Dave finds that instead of upholding the law as a righteous police officer, he has now become a fugitive wanted for murder.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E278 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第278集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Mount CHIAK / 異山怪談
programme.desc: Members of 'GO2MOUNTAIN' bike riding club try valleys of Mount CHIAK where unreal too-cleanly-cut mutilation murders happened. Moments of freedom riding the mountain, odd things happen around them. Will they survive through what that haunts?

programme.title: Reborn / 空心人
programme.desc: Ming & Cheng have a son named Won. One day, Won suddenly had a persistent high fever. As a result, Won died due to lack of rescue. She was very sad and thought that Won was still alive. Then, they meet a person name Xia, who could help people heal the pain of losing their loved ones, Xia gave Cheng a doll, which seemed to be just an ordinary doll, but when it reached her hands, the doll turned into Won. But in Ming eyes, he was just a doll. Xia reminds Ming that this doll must not be damaged. Since then, they have lived happily ever after. But Ming began to feel that Cheng was too obsessed with this illusion and felt that the doll was getting spooky and became an unknown object. He could not stand it and secretly destroyed the doll, but what he didn't expect that Cheng still regarded the broken doll as Won. She thought that he killed her son. Ming started arguing with her, hoping to wake her up, but accidentally injured Cheng, then unexpectedly something happened to Ming...

programme.title: Vital Signs / 送院途中
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: House of Fury / 精武家庭
programme.desc: A mysterious person arrived in his wheelchair in Yue's Clinic and asked for a person called Tai Chi Lung. Later on, Yue was found disappeared, leaving behind his clinic a mess...

programme.title: The Movie Emperor / 紅毯先生
programme.desc: The Hong Kong movie star Lau Wai-chi misses out again on the Hong Kong film awards. He sits in his office, making short videos that pay tribute to the characters he has played over his forty-year career. But trying to regain popularity this way feels desperate and cheap. He needs to make a film again. He contacts Chinese director Lin Hao, as he wants to star in a film shot in the countryside, playing an ordinary farmer, something he has never done before. This film he thinks will help restore his career to glory. Yet he is so used to being a movie star and having a special treatment in his everyday life, that it is hard for him to connect with the people of the street or peasants, people who have a lower social status than him. Even with women, there seems to exist an impassable barrier. For his new role to be successful, he needs to learn from the villagers how they really live and speak. But they see through his arrogance and vanity – as does the crew. The big star is nobod

programme.title: Little Q / 小Q
programme.desc: A story about the life of the guide dog Quill: the love interaction between Little Q and the puppy raiser, the guide dog trainer and the newly blind dessert chef Lee Po Ting - how it earns the trust of Po Ting and makes Po Ting take a new lease of life.

programme.title: Tokyo Revengers 2 : Bloody Halloween-Destiny / 東京復仇者2 血腥萬聖節篇–命運
programme.desc: “I'll save you! Over and over! I'll never give up until I find a future where you're still alive!” Takemichi thought he had saved his ex-girlfriend Hinata...but once again, she was killed by the Tokyo Manji Gang, an organization that had grown violent and corrupt. This time, she was killed right in front of his eyes... The key to saving Hinata was linked to a tragic event that had torn apart the six founding members of Tokyo Manji... Six best friends who swore to die for one another. Why did they turn against each other? The epic battle on Halloween, October 31, would pit best friends against each other and threaten to destroy the Tokyo Manji Gang.

programme.title: Tokyo Revengers 2 : Bloody Halloween-Finale / 東京復仇者2 血腥萬聖節篇–決戰
programme.desc: The intense battle between former friends, which poses a threat to the collapse of Tokyo Manji Gang, has finally begun. Mikey sets out to bring back Baji, who has defected to the enemy, Valhalla. Kazutora, who remains with Valhalla, aims to crush Tokyo Manji Gang and kill Mikey. The tragic past that tore apart the founding members of Tokyo Manji Gang and broke the bonds between the former comrades comes to light. 'I don't want anyone else to die!' Embracing their respective convictions, will Takemichi be able to prevent the worst outcome and create a brighter future? And can he once again save Hinata and the future of his friends?

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Emergency Meeting / 爆谷製造 -危城緊急會議
programme.desc: Hong Kong action disaster blockbuster ‘Cesium Fallout' has brought an ensemble cast of actors from across generations such as Karen Mok and Ivana Wong who played the government executives on-screen and found themselves like old friends despite of their first collaboration in real life. Besides, both reveal the challenging part of their roles in this film. Director Anthony Pun, two-time winner of Hong Kong Film Award for Best Cinematography; and Bill Kong, the producer-presenter of the film, also unveil this arduous journey fraught with challenges during filming and post-production that they navigated to bring their vision of catastrophic disaster to the audience.

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Tse Kwan Ho: Cesium Fallout (Extended version) / 爆谷巨星匯：謝君豪: 焚城 (加長版)
programme.desc: After a fire accident triggers a radiation leakage, the entire city suddenly finds its survival hanging by a thread. In order to tackle the impending catastrophe, expert Simon Fan joins the emergency crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive Cecilia to tackle this catastrophic disaster. With the lives of 7 million people on the line, the fire brigade is tasked with stopping the spread at all costs by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented calamity, will Hong Kong wake up to an overnight annihilation?

programme.title: Making of Cesium Fallout / 焚城的誕生
programme.desc: Directed by Anthony Pun, 'Cesium Fallout' is the first Hong Kong's historic first radiation disaster blockbuster that has won 5 nominations at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards. This documentary has recorded every little bits of behind-the-scene as well as the sharing from Anthony Pun, the cast and the production crew.

programme.title: A Beautiful Moment / 我的情敵女婿
programme.desc: An ageing bachelor playboy finally meets the girl of his dreams and proposes marriage, only to discover her psychologist stepmom was his first love long ago. The future in-laws initially pretend not to know each other but as the wedding date gets nearer, the rekindling of long-dormant feelings develops into a cross-generational love triangle.

programme.title: Exclusive Premiere: Labyrinth / 爆谷獨家首播: 謎攻少女
programme.desc: Shiori, an ordinary high school student, dreams day and night of becoming viral on social media. One day, a crack appears on her smartphone screen and a virtual 'SHIORI' made of data is born. This new-born “SHIORI” not only upending her world but also replacing her real life. Trapped in the digital world, Shiori is powerless to save herself, watching helplessly as her imposter transforms into a vibrant idol and internet celebrity. In this digital Labyrinth, Shiori encounters a mysterious rabbit guy named 'Komori,' who guides her escape this bizarre and algorithm-constructed digital maze. Before herself is completely digitized and forgotten, she must find her way home...

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle / 一個人的武林
programme.desc: A vicious killer Feng is going round Hong Kong killing top martial arts exponents, leaving a secret weapon called the Moonshadow as his calling card. When convicted killer and kung fu expert, Xia, hears of this, he offers to help the police catch the killer, in return for his freedom. Despite their misgivings, the police release the former police martial arts instructor into their custody. With his help, they realize from the chronological order of the victims that the killer is targeting his victims, all the top masters in their martial arts style, following a martial code of training. When Xia also disappears after a close encounter with Feng, they suspect the worse...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: She’s Got No Name / 醬園弄．懸案
programme.desc: Set in a bustling alleyway during the Japanese occupation of Shanghai in the 1940s, the film centres on a wife, Zhan Zhou, who was being charged with the bloody dismemberment of her husband – a killing that seems impossible for her to have committed alone. The murder thrusts Zhan into the spotlight and the court of public opinion, forcing her towards a fate intertwined with that of her own country.

programme.title: Haunting Call / 手機見鬼
programme.desc: Lily, a popular YouTuber reeling from her boyfriend's betrayal, discovers a haunted phone belonging to Xiaoya, a bullied high school student who tragically took her own life. As eerie messages and calls pull Lily into Xiaoya's ghost world, she learns of the spirit's desire for revenge against those who hurt her. Empathizing with Xiaoya's pain, Lily begins to understand the quest for justice. However, she soon realizes that helping Xiaoya seek vengeance comes at a steep cost, and some hauntings can never truly be escaped.

programme.title: Happy End / 快樂到死
programme.desc: Bora Choi, who works at an English language institute, is having an affair with her ex-lover, Il-Beom Kim. Her husband, Min-ki Seo, is a former banker. He has lost his job, and has taken over the domestic roles of the house: cooking, cleaning, and watching the baby. In his free time, he watches soap operas and reads romance novels. Min-ki is aware of the affair, but seems willing to put up with it and to continue living with his cheating wife. Bora is disturbed when Il-Beom seems to want to take their affair further and pushes past her boundaries, risking to expose their relationship.

programme.title: Soul Snatcher / 赤狐書生
programme.desc: To achieve immortality, fox spirit Bai Shisan disguises as a young man and travels to the human world in search of a divine pill. There he befriends the innocent scholar Wang Zijin shom he later realizes is the key to his transcendence. To keep Wang safe, Bai must bond with him on his road to the imperial examination and fends off threats from mythic creatures and evil spirits.

programme.title: Fragments of the Last Will / 來自雪國的遺書
programme.desc: In 1945, after the end of World War II, Hatao Yamamoto was imprisoned in a concentration camp in Sibera, Russia. Despite the harsh, despairing condition in the camp, Hatao Yamamoto kept telling other prisoners not to give up hope, and that the day when they could all go back home would come. Hatao Yamamoto firmly believed that he would return to Japan and meet his wife, Mojimi Yamamoto, and their children someday. 8 years after the war, he received a postcard from his wife with a one-line message written on it, stating that “We are waiting for you to come back”. Meanwhile, Hatao Yamamoto's health was deteriorating rapidly. After having a diagnosis, the doctor told him that he had only three months left... After listening to his friends' advices, he decided to write a will and left it to his friends to bring it to his family when they were released. However, the will was seen as a spying message by the officers in the concentration camp and was confiscated...

programme.title: Exhuma / 破墓
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, the renowned shaman Hwa-rim and her protege Bong-gil are commissioned with a hefty sum to meet the enigmatic descendants of a household afflicted by a peculiar illness. Sensing the ominous aura surrounding the ancestral grave, Hwa-rim urges for its relocation. The best geomancer in the business, Sang-duk, and mortician Young-geun, lured by the scent of money, join the team. The mysterious grave, situated in an unapproachable sacred ground, holds dark secrets. Though Sang-duk senses an ominous presence and initially rejects the proposal, Hwa-rim's persuasion ultimately initiates the exhumation, leading to a journey where the team must confront both supernatural forces and their own fears.

programme.title: Driving Miss Wealthy / 絕世好賓
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: The Battle at Lake Changjin II / 長津湖之水門橋
programme.desc: During the second battle of the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea, the 9th Corps Command issues an order for the 7th Infantry Company to attack the Sumun Bridge. The 7th Company suffers a tough march to the Sumun Bridge. The soldiers are near their limits, every step forward in the midst of the harsh weather only means another great challenge to the body and mind...

programme.title: One Last Bloom / 最後的怒放
programme.desc: Forty years after leaving Japan for a boxing career in the U.S. that never panned out, Jin returns to restart his life with his old boxing buddies. When hotheaded young boxer Shogo asks for Jin's help to get him back into the ring after an unfair loss, the two men decide to seize their final chance at glory.

programme.title: Stuntman / 武替道
programme.desc: LEE Sam was the undisputed king of stunt choreography during the golden era of Hong Kong action cinema in the 80s. After a devastating stunt accident, Sam steps away from the industry for 30 years. However, his old friend, a veteran director, has now persuaded Sam to work as the stunt choreographer on what will be the director's last film. The only catch is that his film stars Wai - Sam's former stunt crew member who has since become a famous action star in his own right. Sam and Wai have a contentious history, with Sam's infamously overbearing and demanding personality clashing with Wai's own ego and ambition. By chance, Sam crosses paths with a young, ambitious stuntman named LEE Sai Long, who sees this as an opportunity to advance his career. Long is caught between Sam and his former protege turned rival. At the same time, Long helps Sam to reconcile with his estranged daughter, Cherry. As Sam returns to the world he once dominated, he must confront his past, mend fences w

programme.title: My Lucky Star / 非常幸運
programme.desc: Going nowhere in love and stuck in life as a lowly travel agent, Sophie finds escape in her own comic book creations. When she was winning the office contest for a prize trip to Singapore suddenly turns her life upside in the best way possible, as she meets there the man of her dreams: David, the handsome super-spy from her own comics. Before she can even get pack her luggage together, off they jump from the Marina Bay Sands Skydeck, and the chase is on for a lip-shaped key to the billion-dollar diamond called “Lucky Star Diamond”, a diamond capable of destroying the world, one country at a time.

programme.title: Gen Z Actresses: My First Of May / Gen Z 女將: 無名指
programme.desc: My First of May follows TANG Suk Yin and his daughter TANG Chi, whose lives are turned upside down when Chi is diagnosed with a serious illness, given little chance to survive past two. Faced with this heart-wrenching reality, Suk Yin and his wife, Elaine YEUNG, promise to cherish every moment with Chi. Miraculously, Chi survives beyond two, but this brings significant changes. The couple sacrifices their dreams to care for her-Suk Yin gives up his squash career, while Elaine, overwhelmed by pressure, abandons the family. In despair, Suk Yin withdraws and becomes a recluse. Without parental support, Chi relies on her grandmother, SUEN Yau Mui. When her grandmother's health deteriorates, Suk Yin can no longer ignore his responsibilities and returns home. After years apart, how will they mend their strained relationships? Unexpectedly, a small understanding from the past helps them reconnect. With Suk Yin's support, Chi gains movement in her ring finger, rekindling love in the

programme.title: Baogu Produces -The Frontline of Cold War / 爆谷製造 -寒戰前哨站
programme.desc: The long-awaited “Cold War” series returns! Director Longman Leung together with Terrance Lau and Louise Wong disclose the untold stories of filming “Cold War 1994”. While Terrance reveals filming car chase scenes had been his brush with death, Louise confesses to being stressed to play the role of a gang boss for the first time that took her three months of preparation for the action scenes. Longman also shares about the tycoon kidnapping case in the film inspired by real cases from the 1990s......

programme.title: MY WORST NEIGHBOR / 隔牆有愛
programme.desc: Flirting with a wall between them! Seung-jin wants to become a singer, so he's preparing for a TV audition program. It's his first night at his new place. He suddenly hears a woman's ghostly wails! It turns out that Seung-jin's next door neighbor, Ra-ni has been driving people away from this apartment because of the super-thin walls! But Seung-jin won't go without a fight! After a battle of loud noises, they decide to take turns being noisy. They don't know each other's names or faces. But as they share their lives, they start to develop strange feelings for each other... The thin walls force them to share everything with each other. It's a brand new kind of romance!

programme.title: CREATION OF THE GODS I / 封神第一部
programme.desc: Long ago, the mystic sages in Kunlun saw that humankind had descended into chaos. A King consumed by his lust for power and aided by evil beings threatened the mortal world. One Immortal was willing to sacrifice his immortality to try and save mankind. Beguiled by a beautiful Fox Demon, there is nothing that can stop the ambitious King Zhou and his band of loyal disciples. The King unleashes a brutal campaign upon the land, and forces the lords of all the other realms to deliver their sons to him as wards. Loyalty to the King is tested against loyalty to family as sons are forced to murder their fathers. Black magic aids the King, but the heavens are on the side of the hero! Can the heavens possibly save mankind? Which will prevail, power or peace...

programme.title: The Lady Improper / 非分熟女
programme.desc: Born in a culinary family, Siu Man has always led an ideal life - Good grades, a financially viable job and a loving husband. But one thing has always plagued her: A fear of intimacy. After the end of her sexless marriage and several life crises, Siu Man reboots her life by taking over her father's restaurant. She hires Jiahao, a ‘culinary philosopher' who takes a creative approach to cooking. To help save the restaurant, Jiahao decides to mentor Siu Man, opening her up to his culinary world. In the process, Siu Man becomes attracted to his masculinity, intelligence and his mastery of culinary skills. After seeing her usually conservative friends let loose at a wedding party, Siu Man realizes that it's time to tackle her fear of intimacy head-on. With the help of a new friend, Siu Man embarks on a journey of liberation, starting with pole dancing lessons and returning to the dating scene. When she secretly spies on Jiahao's wild tryst with another woman, Siu Man finally exper

programme.title: The Policeman's Lineage / 無間對決
programme.desc: Major Crimes captain Park Kang-yoon (Cho Jin-woong) receives special funding to carry out his investigations and lives the life of luxury with fancy sedan, high-end condo, designer suits and accessories. A rookie named Min-jae (Choi Woo-shik) joins his unit, who happens to be very by the book. The pair becomes close as they begin investigating a new type of street drug, but Kang-yoon finds out that there is a mole within his unit, who has been compiling a case against him. As Min-jae is shown into the shady world of slush funds being used on cops, he is exposed to a secret organization within the ranks...

programme.title: An Abandoned Team / 得寵先生
programme.desc: Yam Chun Kai, is a 60-year-old curmudgeon living alone. Forced into retirement, Uncle Kai reflects on his failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter. As the hopelessness prompts him to end his life, a stray dog named Roast Piggy finds Uncle Kai and leads an animal welfare volunteer, Una Tang, to rescue him-the intelligence and humanity of Roast Piggy change Uncle Kai's attitude towards stray animals. Uncle Kai becomes friends with Una and joins her animal shelter 'Warm Home' as a volunteer, helping the abandoned animals. Una hopes Uncle Kai can take this opportunity to clear the air between him and his daughter Zoie. Just as Uncle Kai's life seems to be getting back on track, several dog poisoning incidents occur in the village he lives in...

programme.title: The Roundup: No Way Out / 犯罪都市:鐵拳掃毒
programme.desc: Seven years after the roundup in Vietnam, Ma Seok-do joins a new squad to investigate a murder case. Soon, he finds out this case involves busting a synthetic drug and starts to dig deeper...Meanwhile, the guy behind it all-Joo Sung-chul -doesn't stop looking for trouble, and the Japanese drug distributors, Ricky and his gang, come to Korea to join the chaos. Things are just about to get out of hand...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Lost In Love / 爆谷製造 -信者得愛
programme.desc: Sandra Ng reveals how her admiration for MC (Cheung Tin Fu) has initiated their May-December romance in the film “Love Lies”! During the interview, Sandra not only praises this new generation actor and also recalls the time they spent together in Sapporo. Let's find out how Sandra talks about her interpretation of the lonely, strong woman in the drama, showing everyone a different side of herself.

programme.title: Love Lies / 我談的那場戀愛
programme.desc: 'Love, once believed, is real.' Despite being swindled out of a large sum of money, the well-known gynecologist Yu still insisted that she was in love. Yu, who had been widowed for several years, met Joe, who was disguised as a middle-aged French petroleum engineer and widower, on a dating app, not knowing that he was part of an online scam group. Not only was Yu immersed in the online romance, but Joe also found pleasure and satisfaction in creating romantic experiences for Yu. Two initially unlikable people gradually changed through this online romance that began with deception.

programme.title: Tales From The Occult / 失衡凶間
programme.desc: “Dead Mall” - Wilson runs a popular Youtube channel that offers investment tips. While hosting a livestream that introduces a brand-new shopping mall for potential entrepreneurs, he is confronted by Garuda, an influencer who specializes in exposes. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked avenger also roams the halls of the mall, setting the scene for a shocking reveal about a terrifying incident that happened before the mall's renovation. “The Tenement” - On the stairwell of a tenement building, a soaked mystery figure in a raincoat is blocking the exit. As it slowly creeps upstairs, the building's remaining residents suspect that it's the spirit of a drowning victim. A bold but cautious novelist and her fellow residents turn to Frank Ho, a notorious former triad assassin living on the 5th floor, for help. Under Frank's leadership, the residents start an unusual defense against the ghost on the stairs. “The Chink” - Young pop star Yoyi moves into a new home to have more time with her

programme.title: You're Not Normal, Either! / 老師！你會不會談戀愛
programme.desc: Ohno is an introverted math tutor at a cram school who can barely hold a conversation. He wants to fall in love and get married, like an “ordinary” person, but it just doesn't work out whenever he tries. Then his savior appears: a teenage girl named Kasumi, who knows all about “normal love”. The two of them team up to try and help Ohno in his romance!

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Hi-Five / 超異能特攻
programme.desc: The five ordinary people, who developed their superpowers after receiving organ transplants from a previously superpowered being, fighting against another psychic, who also gained the power through transplant and covets their powers.

programme.title: Wu Xia / 武俠
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi lives a seemingly normal life in a remote village. But his peaceful life is soon to be disrupted when a determined detective digs up his past.

programme.title: Gen Z Actresses: The Lyricist Wannabe / Gen Z 女將: 填詞L
programme.desc: Believing that writing Cantopop is her God-given talent, Law Wing-sze decides to make it her lifelong career. But as hard as Sze tries to polish her lyrics writing skills and expand her social circle, nothing seems to go her way. What if there's a will, but there's no way? The first major motion picture about Cantopop lyrics writing. Norris Wong's long-awaited follow-up to her acclaimed debut My Prince Edward is an unsentimental autobiographical dramedy that reminds us no dream is guaranteed to come true. Ironically, the film's star, up-and-coming actress Chung Suet-ying, is actually a real-life Cantopop lyricist.

programme.title: Dealer Healer / 毒。誡
programme.desc: This is a true story based on a repented gangster preaching the word of God and guiding his brotherhood to turn over a new leaf. Chen once was the leader of the famous gang “The 13 Tsz Wan Shan”, he lost his family, lovers, brothers and finally ended up imprisoned for his drug abuse and trafficking. After jail, he devoted himself to save the lost fellows and was selected as “The JCI Hong Kong Ten Outstanding Young Persons”. Being respected by the world, Chen is always asked to solve the most difficult situations between evil and good. People give him a nickname “The Fixer”. However, there are two sides of a coin, Chen can work out any problem of others, he does not know how to deal with his personal knot with his love, with whom he has had guilty conscience all his life. Can he fix it eventually?

programme.title: One Win / 逆球大叔
programme.desc: Woo-jin's win rate as a coach is less than 10%! Dismissed, expelled, bankrupt, kicked out, divorced...Even in life, he's experiencing defeat after defeat. Then, Pink Storm, a pro volleyball team that is on the brink of disbanding, brings him on as their coach. Pink Storm's ace players have all transferred to another team, so it's currently a team of leftovers. Jung-won buys the team even though the players have no skills and no teamwork. Jung-won, who is obsessed with creating a heartwarming story of losers' growing pains, pledges to give away a total of $2 million if Pink Storm wins just once. Pink Storm becomes the center of attention, but they keep losing. Woo-jin is used to losing, but he still gets frustrated. Even though the players lack experience and potential, he starts to desire one win...

programme.title: Two Thumbs Up / 衝鋒車
programme.desc: Lucifer and his gangsters dress their minibus to resemble a police vehicle, and pose as policemen for a robbery. At the robbery the gangsters engage in a gunfight against the real criminals, who kill randomly. Lucifer and his men are infuriated. They may wear police costumes and use toy guns, but their passion is real. Sensing their righteous passion, Chui decides to side with the imposters and their 16-passenger EU vehicle. Lucifer and his men re-discover the bond they felt when they used to battle together.

programme.title: The Uniform / 夜校女生
programme.desc: Set in 1997's Banqiao, the story explores the struggles and brilliance of a girl named Xiao Ai as she navigates her journey of growth. Originally accepted into her dream high school, Xiao Ai is compelled by her mother to transfer to the night school at Taipei First Girls' High School. Sharing desks with day students during the day, she forms a deep friendship with her 'desk mate,' Min Min. However, feeling inferior because of her identity as a night school student, she and Min Min both develop feelings for the gifted student, Luke. To conceal the truth, she dons the day school uniform and pretends to be the 'perfect girl' who matches Luke. The green uniform gives her confidence, but it also causes her lies to spiral out of control. On the day of the joint entrance exam, the truth is revealed, and Xiao Ai faces a heart-wrenching trial of growth amidst the storms of friendship, love, and family...

programme.title: Tales From The Occult: Body And Soul / 失衡凶間之罪與殺
programme.desc: “Rapunzel”- Has-been idol Maggie had her career breakthrough with a famous advertisement featuring her hair. Though her career has waned considerably, a rare invitation to a movie audition sparks her longing for a comeback. On the night before the audition, Maggie's hair is burnt in a prank at a private party. To ensure that her damaged hair doesn't prevent her path back to stardom, Maggie finds a hair salon in the middle of the night... “Cheshire Cat”- A string of cat abuses shocks the city. Animal protection volunteers Nora and Aaron not only run a home for stray cats; they also go out and save them from the streets. One day, Johnnie, a man who tracks cat abusers, tells them about rumors of infamous cat abuser “Cat's Eye”... “Tooth Fairy”- Dental nurse Sammi ran into chef Hin after an incident on the street. When Hin goes to the clinic where Sammi works for an examination, dentist Steve, who harbors a crush on Sammi, tortures Hin. When Sammi goes to check on Hin, he shows s

programme.title: The Roundup: Punishment / 犯罪都市: 鐵拳清算
programme.desc: While investigating a drug-trafficking app, “Monster Cop” Ma Seok-do and his team discover a connection between the app's developer, who was murdered in the Philippines, and an illegal online gambling organization. Meanwhile, in the Philippines, Baek Chang-gi is controlling the Korean online illegal gambling market and spreading terror with kidnap, assault and murder. His partner, the IT genius Chang Dong-cheol, is planning an even larger scheme in Korea itself. To put an end to the escalating threat, Detective Ma expands his operation by proposing an unexpected alliance... The fourth instalment in the Roundup series.

programme.title: Memories / 回憶三部曲
programme.desc: From the creative supervision of Katsuhiro OTOMO ('STEAMBOY', 'SHORT PEACE'), comes 'MEMORIES', a three-part work based on OTOMO's three original stories. ('MAGNETIC ROSE') Set in outer space at the end of the 21st century, the 1st part tells the story of two engineers who encounter the apparition of a female opera singer in an abandoned space freighter... ('STINK BOMB') The 2nd story is a satirical tale of a young lab technician who accidentally swallows experimental pills... ('CANNON FODDER') The 3rd part depicts war-time life in an imaginary world, using a characteristic camerawork.

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity / 72家租客
programme.desc: Past and present survival of the common man in the big city - ups and downs, laughters and tears... In 1970s Hong Kong, rapacious landlords try to evict 72 tenants but sworn brothers Ha Kugn and Shek Kin help the group of 72 defeat the landlord and landlady and coincidentally rescue Pinky from a planned forced marriage. When both sworn brothers fall for Pinky and propose to her, she flips a coin 'heads or tails' and Ha wins her hand in marriage. The sworn brothers become sworn enemies and Shek's hatred fuels intense rivalry against Ha in business dealings ranging from the manufacture of plastic flowers to the selling of stinky bean curd. Even after 40 years they continue to clash and in 2010 they are in keen competition selling electronics appliances in Sai Yeung Choi Street, Mongkok, the busiest street in the city and still home to the 72 tenants. In fiercely competitive Sai Yeung Choi Street high rents force businessmen to use every means to survive, with electronics shops

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2 / 金雞2
programme.desc: Set in the year 2046, 82-year-old Golden Chicken Ah Gum spots a heartbroken man planning to take memory loss-pills. She begins to recap her life story starting in 2003.

programme.title: Living in the Sky / 在我和天空之間
programme.desc: Naomi works for a small publishing company in the suburbs. After the sudden death of parents, she and her cat move into a towering building arranged by her uncle. But the sense of loss still makes her feel unreal. One day, she meets star actor Morinori...

programme.title: Adventure of The King / 龍鳳店
programme.desc: Emperor Zhengde of the Ming Dynasty is young and playful, privately escapes from Palace to avoid the appointed marriage. He loses his memory by accident and luckily comes across Ms. Li to take care him. Prince Ningxia takes this opportunity to rebel the kingdom and catch the emperor to execute him immediately at the execution ground. At a critical time, three entourages rescue the Emperor and the prince Ningxia is arrested. However, Ms Li has refused to get marriage with the emperor due to his cheating on her love feelings.

programme.title: Another World / 世外
programme.desc: Tasked to help transient souls through Another World to their reincarnation, the spirit GUDO meets a young girl called YURI, and embarks on a dangerous journey to help her overcome her anger and prevent her curse from destroying the world.

programme.title: Gen Z Actresses: The Dumpling Queen / Gen Z 女將: 水餃皇后
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang Jianhe, a woman from Qingdao, was forced to leave her hometown with her two daughters. To make ends meet and raise her children, she washed dishes by day and cleaned cars by night. With no one to rely on, she bore the immense pressure alone. Determined to break free from her fate, Zang Jianhe decided to make a living by selling dumplings. From struggling to attract customers to eventually thriving, she received much support from tough-but-kind Hong Jie, Brother Hua, and Uncle Dessert. Through perseverance, she grew her dumpling business into a success, and her life gradually opened up to new possibilities... The film is based on a true story.

programme.title: Chaos / 三不管
programme.desc: In one of the darkest and diverse cultural part in the city, there is a minority group who lives in the place where it is full of despair and frustration. At first glance, their desperate living comprises illegal gambling, prostitution as well as drug-dealing. Indeed, their way of living is guided by their own norms and laws, regardless of the entrenched ones prevailing in the general public. Although their norms are chaotic and arbitrary, they do not violate the existence of the conventional ones. Consequently, it can be said that this chaotic region is unique within the city. On one occasion, there are two men, riding in a vehicle, unexpectedly enter this restricted region...

programme.title: Ip Man 3 / 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs...

programme.title: Kung Fu Master Is My Grandma! / 我的婆婆黃飛鴻
programme.desc: Gucci, an ordinary teenage girl grows up in a single-parent family. In order to protect her good friend, she fights with somebody and is sent to girls' home. After release, she knows her mother died in a car accident. So she doesn't have a choice but to live with her weird grandmother, Wong Fei Hung. Gucci does not like Wong's old-fashion and strange character and they always quarrel about some unimportant issues. Gucci has fallen in love with a bartender. However, happy times always can't last, bad luck seems still follow Gucci......

programme.title: Still Human / 淪落人
programme.desc: A paralyzed and hopeless man meets his new Filipino domestic helper who has put her dreams on hold to come to Hong Kong to earn a living. These two strangers live under the same roof, and they learn to face the different seasons of life.

programme.title: Wolf Children / 狼的孩子雨和雪
programme.desc: Hana falls in love with a 'wolf man' and gives birth to two babies. One day, wolf man passed away. Hana takes her children and move away from the crowded city to a small town...

programme.title: Tales From The Occult: Ultimate Malevolence / 失衡凶間之惡念之最
programme.desc: “Killing Me Softly”- Magician Flora repeatedly sees illusions of her friend Maureen, who has gone missing since their last call. In an attempt to trace clues of Maureen's missing, Flora undergoes hypnosis to retrieve the memory of their conversation. Little does she know she is putting herself in danger. “No Way Out”- Ho wakes up from sleep and finds himself inside a mysterious industrial building. While looking for an exit, he bumps into corpses, phantoms, and even his ex-wife. He must find his way out before it's too late. “Memento Mori”- Two secondary school best friends, Tam and Yu, dream of becoming movie directors one day. In an accident, one unintentionally kills the other and becomes a director because of this incident.

programme.title: Project Silence / 末日廝殺橋
programme.desc: Due to sudden deteriorating weather conditions, visibility on the Airport Bridge is severely impaired, leaving people stranded and at risk of the bridge collapsing due to a series of chain collisions and explosions. Amidst the chaos, the canine subjects 'Echo' from the military experiment 'Project Silence,' who were being transported in secret, break free, and all human survivors become targets of relentless attacks. Various individuals find themselves stranded on the Airport Bridge for different reasons - a government official from the presidential office who was seeing off his daughter at the airport; a tow truck driver who was on his way to a multi-collision scene; an elderly who were returning from a trip abroad; sisters who missed their flights, and Dr. Yang, the researcher responsible for Project Silence - and a desperate struggle begins for them to escape to safety.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen / 我們的十八歲
programme.desc: This is a story about how family can impact the growth of a young woman. It follows Elaine, who grew up in poverty in the 1980's, and her best friend Ying as they enter the Hong Kong entertainment industry to change their fate. In the golden era of Hong Kong cinema, Ying becomes a popular erotic star while Elaine struggles between her identity and her job as an actor. When Hong Kong cinema's glory fades a decade later, the two women end up on diverging paths due to their life choices.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Ip Man 4 The Finale / 葉問4完結篇
programme.desc: Ip Man's life remains unchanged after his wife's death, but he and his son are slowly drifting apart. To seek a better future for his son, Ip Man decides to travel to the U.S. only to find the stable, peaceful life abroad is only skin deep. Underneath lies a deep rooted racial discrimination that is far worse than he has expected. Ip Man re-examines his position and ponders on the reason he took up martial arts in the beginning.

programme.title: Love and the Grand Tug-of-war / 愛情扯大纜
programme.desc: A story of the sad love between a man who dedicates his youth to the nearly 420-year-old tradition of the Sendai Grand Tug-of-War, and a Korean medical resident who works on Koshiki island, and what happens with them and their families.

programme.title: Citizen of a Kind / 反詐師奶兵團
programme.desc: The scammer who scammed my money asked for help! Duk-hee, an energetic woman looking into various loans due to a laundry fire, receives a call from a bank clerk named Son offering a reasonable loan. Sending money to Son who demanded various fee for the loan, she later realizes that the entire process was a voice phishing scam, leaving her in shock. Having lost her entire fortune and forced to live on the streets with her children, Duk-hee receives another call from Son one day... This time, it's a plea for help! Determined to rescue the scammer and recover her lost money, Duk-hee equips herself with various skills and, along with her colleagues, who are equally determined, to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Nightfall / 大追捕
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong celebrity is found brutally murdered, detective Lam is called in to take charge. But the more that Lam pursues his suspect, the deeper he falls into a web of lies.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E226 -Time Still Turns The Pages / 爆谷電影現場 第226集 -年少日記
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Gen Z Actresses: Time Still Turns The Pages / Gen Z 女將: 年少日記
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng looks back to his repressed childhood memories, as he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. He strives hard to prevent another tragedy from happening, meanwhile facing a series of family problems, his wife is divorcing him, and his father is dying.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E260 -Dongji Rescue / 爆谷電影現場 第260集 -東極島
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Dongji Rescue / 東極島
programme.desc: DONG JI ISLAND follows the tragic tale of a Japanese warship secretly transporting British prisoners of war and mistakenly attacked near the easternmost waters of China. To rescue the desperately trapped prisoners, a group of courageous islanders embark on a perilous journey against all odds to the sinking ship, facing relentless Japanese soldiers and the harsh, unforgiving seas...

programme.title: Mad World / 一念無明
programme.desc: The film begins with an old man who has long been absent as a father, picking up his son, who is suffering from bipolar disorder, from a mental hospital. Both men are in deep remorse for the accident that caused the death of the mother. The tension and anxiety boil as they stay with each other in a tiny subdivided flat. As time passes, they realize the pain between one another is not the only confrontation that awaits them; but to face the cruel world that they are living in.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -The Champion Dream of Peter Ho-sun Chan (Full Ver.) / 爆谷製造 -陳可辛的奪冠夢 (足本版)
programme.desc: Baogu Produces: The Champion Dream of Peter Ho-sun Chan (Full Ver.) is a sit down interview with the film's director to unveil the most anticipated questions for Peter Ho-sun Chan's box office hit LEAP, which is one of the contenders for the 93rd Academy Awards' Best International Feature Film competition.

programme.title: My Troublesome Buddy / 我的麻煩老友
programme.desc: A-Gan is a mean and stingy but successful salesman. One day he has a car accident and meets his own conscious. His Conscious just gives him 7 days to live. A-Gan convinces it to let him live on if 7 people come and visit him. Disappointed by his colleagues' attitudes, A-Gan meets A-Tong, a girl who is as rude and mean as him. They finally change their bad personalities and A-Gan saves his own life by having 7 visitors.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident / 新宿事件
programme.desc: The foreign migrant communities in Tokyo live shadowy lives. The Japanese neither acknowledge nor welcome them. They are shunned by the mainstream society, hounded by the yakuza, and go about their days under fear of being discovered and repatriated. It is an alien world for Steelhead – an honest, hardworking tractor repairman. Steelhead had decided to take the perilous journey to Tokyo after he lost contact with his girlfriend, who had arrived in the city earlier.

programme.title: Pilot / 男航女機師
programme.desc: HAN Jung-woo, a pilot with top-class skills, is flying high and even appears on a famous TV show. But everything comes crashing down when a careless mistake causes him to lose everything, even his job. Blacklisted in the industry, no airline is willing to hire him. Desperate with no other choice, HAN Jung-woo transforms completely into his younger sister's identity and succeeds in landing a job as a pilot. But soon, he encounters more unexpected problems... Will his dream of cruising through life ever take off?

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Cross Four Trails Challenge / 爆谷製造 -跨越四徑挑戰
programme.desc: Among Hong Kong's trail running community, there is a legendary mountain race that runners have to complete in total distance of 298km in 72 hours. Without any cash-prize or award for this challenge, passionate runners keep challenging their own perseverance. Director Robin Lee has won the Best New Director award at the Hong Kong Film Awards for his debut documentary “Four Trails”. In this interview, Lee together with runner Jacky Leung will talk about their stories of pain and glory brought by this extreme challenge.

programme.title: Four Trails / 香港四徑大步走
programme.desc: At the time, they said it couldn't be done. In 2012, Andre Blumberg set off by himself, to run all four of Hong Kong's iconic ultra distance trails in just four days. 298km and over 14,500m of climbing later, one of the hardest ultra marathons in the world - the Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge - was born. With the 2021 edition of the challenge as the backdrop, 'Four Trails' takes you on a journey from when the concept was first was conceived to it's current format. Under 60 hours to be deemed a 'Finisher' and under 72 hours to be a ‘Survivor', unsupported and with an ever evolving set of rules. It takes a deep dive into the famous four trails that make up the challenge and you will both laugh and cry as the astonishing stories of those who dare attempt such a feat unfold.

programme.title: Crayon Shinchan The Movie: Our Dinosaur Diary / 蠟筆小新劇場版：我們的恐龍日記
programme.desc: Shinchan is really excited about the coming summer holiday! What's amazing about this summer is that there is a special news that shocks the whole world - A “Dinosaur Park” that revives extinct dinosaurs is opened in Tokyo! What's more, the Kasukabe Team receives a special invitation to explore the new park! The team enjoys the facilities in the world-renowned “Dinosaur Park” while having a close look on giant dinosaurs, and become so excited about everything they see! After opening of the park, a dinosaur fever is all the rage worldwide! At the same time, Shiro meets a little dinosaur called “Nana” at the riverside. As Shinchan and his friends beg sincerely, Nana becomes a member of the Nohara family, living together with Shinchan and Shiro, and creates a lot of wonderful memories. However, when Shinchan is enjoying this unique summer, dinosaurs suddenly escape from the park and rush into Tokyo! How will this “Dinosaur Crisis” end? What is the secret behind Nana's appearance

programme.title: Missing / 失蹤
programme.desc: In 2005, a high-profile case of a police officer who disappeared during a forest hike spawned urban legends about the existence of a gateway into another world. In 2016, those legends inspired popular internet novel Missing, which is now being adapted into an eerie supernatural thriller by first-time director and Fresh Wave alum Ronnie Chau. Former pop idol Gillian Chung stars as a social worker who hires a mountain guide to search for her missing father in the mountains. She discovers the mystical gateway from the urban legends, but is her father really waiting for her on the other side?

programme.title: Honest Candidate 2 / 誠實選舉媽 2
programme.desc: After failing to win the Seoul mayoral election, Joo Sang-sook became an unemployable property and no parties will admit to associating with her in fear of bad press, but when she rescues a young man from drowning, she is suddenly pulled into spotlight and wins the election to become the Gangwon province governor. But her honesty sinks her approval rating and she resorts back to lying through her teeth. As fate would have it, her truth mouth returns! Not only that, her chief of staff Hee-cheol is cursed with the same truth bomb!

programme.title: Railway Heroes / 鐵道英雄
programme.desc: Winter in 1939, southern Shandong Province, railway workers Hong and Wang led a guerrilla force active on the railway line. In a snowy night, Hong led a group of people, including Qi Lu and Lin Dong, to assassinate three senior Japanese officials, which enraged the Japanese army. Fujiwara, a senior Japanese agent, arrived discreetly and had initiated an investigation. The railway squad and Fujiwara went head-to-head with rounds of hard battles, during which the railway squad sacrificed three members and Wang's undercover identity was revealed. At this time, a train carrying crucial Japanese armaments was about to pass by, and the railway crew members chose to step up and fight the enemy to the death at this vital juncture.

programme.title: The Warlords / 投名狀
programme.desc: In the fall of 1870, General Pang stands high atop the city walls fully attired in governor's robes. Peering down upon the site of his inauguration, he is filled with dreams and ambition. Pang has taken a path of no return; had he chosen differently, he might have been one of the heroes to later overthrow the corrupt Qing imperial regime. He could have changed the course of history. But two bandits and a woman have changed the course of his life, helping him achieve his goal, but ultimately causing his demise. The two bandits are his sworn blood brothers: Zhao Er-Hu and Jiang Wu-Yang...

programme.title: Gen Z Actresses: Blossoms Under Somewhere / Gen Z 女將: 寄了一整個春天
programme.desc: Ching, a high school girl who wants to fall in love but feels isolated due to being born with a stutter, runs an online business with Rachel, her only friend. Ching unexpectedly gains the attention and love of buyers. As she submerges herself in this unethical business, Ching believes she has found true love. However, she is unaware that she has lost her only friendship.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E278 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第278集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.
