programme.title: I Want To Be Rich / 做個有錢人
programme.desc: Success in business, having a happy family, and being a rich one is what most people wish for. This is also the wish of the young man A Hwa! Those who are hardworking, responsible and know how to be grateful will surely be rich and become wealthy!

programme.title: I DID IT MY WAY / 潛行
programme.desc: In the new century, the fight against drugs faces an unprecedented and difficult challenge! Under the deep and complex dark network, an invisible war is being waged in Hong Kong...... Typhoon signal was hoisted in Hong Kong. Under the cover of the fierce wind, four tons of methamphetamine were entering Hong Kong, pending to be sold on the dark network. A cyber revelry of druggies was about to be unveiled, and a storm was brewing in the quiet Victoria Harbour. Police had to arrest the “boss” behind the scenes and nip the “drug network” in the bud in no time, that pushed their undercover intelligence to the narrow road. In the center of the storm, undercover agents, police officers, drug lords, black, white, and gray entangled.

programme.title: Thunderstruck Cop / 超能神探
programme.desc: One day, Hyun-joon, a policeman who lives with his mother and his daughter, attains a superpower after getting struck by the lightning. After the incident, Hyun-joon realizes that there are others who have been going through the same situation with him, and gets involved with unexpected situations. Will he be able to succeed both, as a father who struggles with the relationship with his daughter, and as a cop with a superpower who is eager to catch an evil criminal?

programme.title: Keep Rolling / 好好拍電影
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Dongbei, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalized characters

programme.title: The Last Supper / 王的盛宴
programme.desc: The early history of a nation unfolds through the actions of three heroes – Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Han Xin – who chased their dreams of uniting a warring nation and fought through major milestones of the Chu-Han Contention years in the third century. From the Julu War to the Hongmen Banquet, the Gaixia War to the death of HanXin, the narration of Liu Bang – who would be the founding emperor of the new Han Dynasty – sets the stage for a tale of betrayal and brothers at war, where the last man standing inherits a nation.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story / 闔家辣
programme.desc: The COVID-19 pandemic offered white-collar workers everywhere the chance to work from home. At first, it seemed like a luxury to be able to work outside the shackles of the office, but people quickly realized that it could also drive them insane. For Coba, work-from-home has led to a daily cage match with his family. When he inadvertently learns that his mother's homemade chili sauce is a hit with his co-workers, he convinces his family to turn the chili sauce into an online business in order to divert their attention away from conflicts. However, Coba didn't expect that the sauce would become a timely internet sensation, thanks to families eating at home more often during the pandemic.

programme.title: Joint Security Area / JSA安全地帶
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight...

programme.title: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes / 通往夏天的隧道，再見的出口
programme.desc: The Urashima Tunnel grants a wish to those who enter... with a price. Kaoru Tono appears elusive but has a heavy heart rooted in a traumatic accident in the past. Anzu Hanashiro seems stronghearted but suffers from the gap between her ideal self and reality. The two team up as allies to investigate the mysterious tunnel in order to get what they want. It is an unforgettable, nostalgic story that sweeps past a summer in the countryside.

programme.title: Truth or Dare : 6th Floor Rear Flat / 六樓后座
programme.desc: Six twentysomethings from their own worlds converge at a bargain apartment affordable by one but perfect for six. With a goal to reach, a deal they make, and a year to complete, they 'fulfill' them with indulging pleasures and, endless games of truth or dare, and madness nourishing the 6th Floor Rear Flat. Sweet Dreams die well when the 12-month lease ends come an unwelcome reminder, the lost souls wake with frightening awareness to the touchline once they think never impossible. Between being responsible and getting away, is youth still a mighty weapon for failures?

programme.title: Madalena / 馬達．蓮娜
programme.desc: Early spring in the city of Macau. Mada (Louis Cheung), a divorced man in his 40's, is the strong and silent type. He lives in a dilapidated flat that's set for demolition. Suffering from a serious case of amnesia, Mada works the graveyard shift as a taxi driver to overcome the pain of his affliction. One night, Mada picks up Lena (Chrissie Chau), who works as a restaurant receptionist by day and a bar hostess by night. After a misunderstanding sparks spark their friendship, Mada becomes Lena's driver, picking her up before and after work. Lena's arrival finally brings some color into Mada's life; he even begins to think that he can finally move on from his divorce. Yet, Lena feels lonely in Macau; she's disliked by her colleagues, who all think that she is a ruthless, money-grubbing hustler for using her voluptuous figure to get special treatment. Lena knows Mada's feelings for her, but she, too, is hiding a past that she can't get over...

programme.title: LOVE RESET / 30日求「分」大作戰
programme.desc: “I was perfect until God threw this woman into my life” JUNG-YEOL, the intelligent and handsome loser. “He's like a mosquito. Who knows why they exist?” NARA, the successful careerwoman born with a side of crazy. Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again. But......with D-30 until they stamp their papers, a fateful accident inflicts amnesia on the star-crossed couple.

programme.title: Why me, Sweetie?! / 失憶界刂女王
programme.desc: Ding studies drama in Beijing. One day, she helps her friend chase after her boyfriend, running vigorously on a Beijing street where she bumps into Dong. The next day, Ding visits Dong, who, strangely enough, denies their acquaintance. Dong's buddy Dr Ching diagnoses his erratic behavior as the protection mechanism of human brain. The only way to lessen the pain is to erase or repress happy memories...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: Gen Z Actresses: Measure in Love / Gen Z 女將: 他年她日
programme.desc: Measure in Love is set in the universe where a massive earthquake has divided the world into Aurora Zone and Evergreen Zone, and the “Wall of Gravity” standing in the middle of the sea distorts time and gravity differently on both sides. One day in Aurora Zone equals one year in Evergreen Zone. When Ann-Jean from the Aurora Zone meets Tato from the Evergreen Zone, can their love break through the irresistible fate of time differences?

programme.title: Where's Officer Tuba / 霹靂大喇叭
programme.desc: Tuba is a policeman, but because of his timid character, he spends his days in the Police Band as a tuba player. Inspector Chow sees the potential in Tuba and arranges him to investigate the case together. Unfortunately, Chow gets killed at work, but his ghost helps Tuba to crackdown on the villains...

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4 / 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: The Buddhist Monk and the Taoist Priest, both blessed with ghost-taming powers, have been quarrelling all over the landscape. Still, they are good friends. The Priest shepherds a group of corpses home. He has to fight off some vicious devils. The Priest's classmate has been assigned the job of accompanying the coffin of a prince back to the capital. One night, a thunderbolt rips the coffin and the prince becomes a vampire. He kills many people. The Priest asks to help. He finds his classmate has killed himself...

programme.title: Chaos By Design / 愛情謎語
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends...

programme.title: Aces Go Places V / 新最佳拍檔
programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak to steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove. White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.

programme.title: Beyond's Diary / BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: This is the story of four aspiring young men striving to fight for their own goals. Kui and his family are intent upon emigrating to another country and they put all their energy in making as much money as possible in order to leave Hong Kong sooner. However just as their goal is about in sight, over-exertion causes Kui to fall ill...Keung is a smart and aggressive young man whose ambition is to make it in the world. But misfortune descends upon him when discovering that he and his family are duped by his boss...It has been a childhood dream of Chung to join the police force but his fragile frame of a body is far from satisfactory, so he turns to conducting traffic and handing out tickets to unfortunate drivers amid the bustles of the streets. However, his virtue is not appreciated...Wing is a diligent and self-absorbed student. His goal is to be one of the chosen few at his college's Music Department but he is dissuaded by his girlfriend's father. In the end he gives in and

programme.title: Eighth Happiness / 八星報喜
programme.desc: Fai, the eldest, has met Fong. Long is a guy with many girl-friends. A girl working in a deparment store has become his target. Sung, is a timid artist. Ying comes into his life...

programme.title: Chaos By Design / 愛情謎語
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends...

programme.title: Dreams Of Glory, A Boxer's Story. / 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon...

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow III / 英雄本色III
programme.desc: The year is 1974. A young Hong Kong Chinese, Mark, travels to Saigon to make his fortune. There, he encounters a mysterious femme fatale, the lovely Kit. As he becomes more involved in her various underworld deals, a tragic romance develops. On the eve of the outbreak of war, Kit's past returns to endanger her, and Mark must risk everything for the one true love of his life...

programme.title: United We Stand / 飛躍羚羊
programme.desc: Alias “Springing Gazelle”, the renowned athlete Miss Chi Cheng is in Hong Kong helping to organize a training programme and hunt for a coach. Olivia was a former brilliant sprinter who has to give up running after her injury in a competition. At the beginning of the training, the girls are too pompous that they despise Olivia, until they find that Olivia is beyond their challenge, they adore her and are willing to go through the hardship but after a winning contest, they feel hostility towards each other and behave proudly. As a result, they lost in the competition with Singapore team. Olivia is so furious...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Fully Funny - Eric Kot / 影人映語 -葛來FUN多 - 葛民輝
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.title: Why, Why, Tell Me Why / 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious...

programme.title: The Inspector Wears Skirts II / 神勇飛虎霸王花
programme.desc: Hong Kong's police force boasts of two of the world's finest anti-crime task forces-the Flying Tigers and the Banshees. After Madam Hu and her Banshees have put ringleaders of a notorious jewelry gang behind the bars, they return to routine training. New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them...

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles / 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely...

programme.title: Prison On Fire / 監獄風雲
programme.desc: The plot mostly involves the two main characters, Ching and Yiu and problems they face with Mickey, a fellow inmate and “Scarface”, a high-ranking officer. Yiu is sentenced to three years for manslaughter. In a fight for his father, he kicked a man onto the path of a bus. Ching was sent to prison for killing his wife for being a prostitute. During the end of the film, inmates decide to go on hunger strike to protest against the cigarette price rise, this causes problems with “Assassin”. Ching bit “Scarface”‘s ear off and gets an extended sentence, Yiu is released from the prison.

programme.title: The Duel / 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: The story is set in the Ming dynasty. 'Holy Sword' requests a fight with secret agent 009's friend 'God of Sword' to decide the world's best swordsman. During the contest on the roof of the Forbidden City, 009 realises that 'Holy Sword' has sent a double to fight in his place, while he plans to assassinate the emperor. 'Holy Sword' finds himself surrounded by thousands of palace guards but is rescued by 'God of Sword', who wants to complete their championship...

programme.title: Eighth Happiness / 八星報喜
programme.desc: Fai, the eldest, has met Fong. Long is a guy with many girl-friends. A girl working in a deparment store has become his target. Sung, is a timid artist. Ying comes into his life...

programme.title: Lee Rock 1 / 五億探長雷洛傳雷老虎
programme.desc: Andy Lau leads a star-studded cast in this chronicle of one young officer's rise to power within the Hong Kong police force in the 1950s.

programme.title: Why, Why, Tell Me Why / 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious...

programme.title: The Inspector Wears Skirts II / 神勇飛虎霸王花
programme.desc: Hong Kong's police force boasts of two of the world's finest anti-crime task forces-the Flying Tigers and the Banshees. After Madam Hu and her Banshees have put ringleaders of a notorious jewelry gang behind the bars, they return to routine training. New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them...

programme.title: Bury Me High / 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots...

programme.title: Who Is The Craftiest / 奸人本色
programme.desc: Leung Piu a swindler, cheats Yue Nan out of his life savings. This leads to Yue Nan's death, leaving his daughter Winnie behind. The Kang family, long disgusted by Leung's treachery, vow to avenge Yue Nan. They decide to “fight deceit with deceit”, exploiting Leung's greed to lure him into a trap, but Leung outsmarts Kang family. As the conflict escalates, Leung continuously sows discord between Kang's brothers Mon and Chuen. When Leung believes he has triumphed by triggering infighting within Kang family...

programme.title: Killer's Romance / 浪漫殺手自由人
programme.desc: After learning that his father was killed by the notorious Chinatown Triad, Nidaine becomes a cold-blooded killer determined to get his revenge. When one of his assassinations is witnessed by Jenny, Nidaine plans on silencing her forever. Instead, Nidaine finds himself falling for her, and they must now run for their lives from both the cops and the Triad assassins!

programme.title: My Lucky Star / 行運超人
programme.desc: Yip has had bad luck ever since her teenage days. She decides to seek help from famous Feng Shui expert Lai, who discovers that her bad luck is causd by his rival...

programme.title: Magic Cop / 驅魔警察
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling...

programme.title: And I Hate You So / 小親親
programme.desc: Zhang hosts a top radio program that offers advice regarding love affairs. He starts a love-war relationship with Wu, a columnist, when she hears him gossiping on her love life!

programme.title: Superstars Comedy: Twinkle, Twinkle Lucky Stars / 星影週末笑聲匯: 夏日福星
programme.desc: Muscles, Kidstuff, Fung, and the gang are taking a well-needed vacation in Thailand courtesy of the Hong Kong police department. Also on the trip is police inspector Woo on orders to track down a list of drug dealers from informant Ma. Unfortunately, Ma gets whacked by a Thai crime lord, but he tells Woo as he draws his last breath that he mailed the list to his friend in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, Muscles and the gang are shaking down Lau, a drug dealer who, it turns out, is being targeted by the same baddies that killed Ma...

programme.title: Taoism Drunkard / 鬼馬天師
programme.desc: In the Taoist Temple of Dragon Tiger Mountain, there lived a Drunken Taoist whose behavior and appearance were different from ordinary people. He was punished to find a virgin boy who was born in the year of 'Sun Mou', the 15th of August of midnight for the consecration of new idol. In order to find that virgin boy, he was unfortunately involved in a murdering case. Many years ago, in the Science Clan, there was a Starry Devil who was cruel and brutal and often committed the rules of the Clan. On one occasion, while he was trying to steal the Leader's Writ, he was being discovered and punished by peeling off his hand's skin then expelled out of the Clan. Wu's grandmother was one of the executors and also the protector of the writ...

programme.title: Spooky Encounters / 鬼打鬼
programme.desc: Courageous Cheung (Sammo Hung) has the reputation of being the bravest man around. Carrying such a reputation often leads him to accept various challenges to test his courage. His wife's secret lover is a wealthy and powerful man who wishes Cheung out of his way before he discovers his wife's infidelity. Hiring a taoist priest to get rid of him, Cheung is challenged to spend the night in an old abandoned temple were the priest will use his dark magic to attempt to bring an end to Cheung's life.

programme.title: Bury Me High / 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots...

programme.title: Story Of Ricky / 力王
programme.desc: Ricky is sent to prison. In the jail, he sees the prisoners being exploited and tortured by chief warden Cobra. Ricky decides to stand up against them. After many setbacks, Ricky gets the support of the other prisoners...

programme.title: Who Is The Craftiest / 奸人本色
programme.desc: Leung Piu a swindler, cheats Yue Nan out of his life savings. This leads to Yue Nan's death, leaving his daughter Winnie behind. The Kang family, long disgusted by Leung's treachery, vow to avenge Yue Nan. They decide to “fight deceit with deceit”, exploiting Leung's greed to lure him into a trap, but Leung outsmarts Kang family. As the conflict escalates, Leung continuously sows discord between Kang's brothers Mon and Chuen. When Leung believes he has triumphed by triggering infighting within Kang family...

programme.title: Iron Sister / 鐵妹
programme.desc: The Story is set in the period during the Japanese invasion of China in the 1930's. A Chinese traitor Tung working within the puppet state of Manchukuo, gets involved in an affair with the mistress of a military officer. Their affair is exposed and in the confusion, Tung kills the officer and has to flee from the Japanese. In the desolate arid lands, his life is saved by Iron Sister, a member of guerrillas from a nearby hunting village, whom has an affair later with Tung. The humble villagers are very simple minded and only wished to drive out the Japanese. They fall easy prey, as Tung disguises his real identity and continues his secret contacts with his collaborators. One by one, the villagers become victims of Tung's ploy. Accidentally his plot is discovered by Iron Sister and they engage in a battle of life and death.

programme.title: 92' The Legendary La Rose Noire / 九二黑玫瑰對黑玫瑰
programme.desc: As soon as Tony Leung, starts imitating the stilted dialogue of 60s heartthrob Lui Kei, film lovers know they've entered a circle of movie-in-jokes and self-conscious world.

programme.title: Duel To The Death / 生死決
programme.desc: The best swordsmen of China and Japan have made it a historical ritual to meet every 10 years for a showdown of fighting skills and powers. The leading fighter of the Japanese ninjas, Hashimoto, and the Chinese chief Ching Wan have come to respect each other after they met, but tradition demands that they lock swords. Their honor is put to the test when rogue ninjas barge into the battlefield...

programme.title: Eastern Condors / 東方禿鷹
programme.desc: “Eastern Condors” was the top secret mission of Department of Defense in the United States in 1987. The mission was to destroy the munitions left over in Vietnam during the Vietnam War. Since it was the top secret mission, Lieutenant Lam could only select Chinese felons from the Federal prison lured by the right of residence and big money to execute the mission. As the irregular troop, they just had informal training before they went to Vietnam. During the mission, they had to pass over mountains and challenge their own wills. They started with no trust to become mutually supportive with one another at the end. However, only few of them were able to come back eventually.

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Michael Wong / 影人映語 -型「德」起！ - 王敏德
programme.desc: Michael Wong rose to prominence on the big screen in the 80s with his “half Chinese, half foreign' identity and eye-catching appearance, from the early rebellious and unruly big boy to the tough and strong policeman role later. Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor?

programme.title: The Case Of The Cold Fish / 月黑風高
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop / 大內密探零零發
programme.desc: Fat is a neglected member of 'The King's Guardian'. Kam dynasty uses an excuse to assassinate the Emperor. Fat smells the trouble and goes along secretly to protect the Emperor...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Tats Lau / 影人映語 -方丈的闊達 - 劉以達
programme.desc: After formed the musical group “Tat Ming Pair”, Tats Lau had been involved as a film composer in the industry for the first time. His taciturn image was changing over when he was invited by Stephen Chow to have a cameo in one of his works; then Lau's another role playing the abbot even provided a major boost to his career as a comedy actor. How does he feel when looking back at his experience throughout these years? Also, perceiving that Hong Kong is his ‘root', what kind of wisdom he would like to share with the audience?

programme.title: Brief Encounter In Shinjuku / 錯在新宿
programme.desc: Foon, a Public Relations manager, starts a happy life with his wife Ann after remarrying her. Kwan, a new public relation officer in Foon's department, falls in love with Foon after he shields her from being criticized, when there is friction between Foon and Ann. Thus Foon falls in love with Kwan gradually. After a business trip to Tokyo, their relationship becomes much closer, while Ann meets Chu, a councilor, who falls in love with her but can't get Ann's response. When returning to Hong Kong, Kwan doesn't want to destroy Foon's family and decides to marry her fianc? When Foon is depressed by this, Ann finds out the truth. Another rupture breaks out again.

programme.title: The Stormriders / 風雲雄霸天下
programme.desc: Nie Feng (Wind) and Bu Jingyun (Cloud) are raised by Xiong Ba of World Society, helping him to conquer the world. But Xiong Ba is their mutual enemy who killed their fathers...

programme.title: Esprit D'Amour / 陰陽錯
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?.

programme.title: 90’s Hotties Collection: Fatal Vacation / 爆谷星影好戲：90‘s女神駕到！: 安樂戰場
programme.desc: Travel agent Bob is very good at organizing Hong Kong tours to the Philippines. The tourists come in grooves. There are the spoiled rich girl, the ladies with loose morals, the grand parents with the child, twin brothers, the cops on holiday and the hoods on holiday: Quite a motley lot. But everything goes wrong. They are hijacked by armed Philippine bandits who hold them as hostages to bargain for the release of their captured leader. They torture and kill off the hostages daily to put pressure on the government. The tourists decide to resist...

programme.title: A Chinese Ghost Story / 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: A rainstorm compelled Ling to trespass Lan Po Temple for a night. Ling meets attractive Siu Seen. Being unaware of Lit's murder, he is madly in love with Siu Seen...

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop / 大內密探零零發
programme.desc: Fat is a neglected member of 'The King's Guardian'. Kam dynasty uses an excuse to assassinate the Emperor. Fat smells the trouble and goes along secretly to protect the Emperor...

programme.title: For Your Heart Only / 為你鍾情
programme.desc: Disc jockey Piggy Chan, mechanic Sapi and cousin Hayden are good friends. Three of them form a trio - LOVEBURSTERS. Piggy falls in love at first sight with Jane Yu. He tears down all obstacles to win her heart. With the victory, he resumes his inclination to flirt around. His friends and relatives are very upset to see him deserting Jane...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Sammo Hung (Part 2) / 影人映語 -洪家班靠「搏」出位 – 洪金寶 (下)
programme.desc: In the last episode, Sammo Hung shared his story of being an action-choreographer, director and actor for over half a century in the film industry. Now he is going to talk more about apprenticeship with his master Yu Jim-yuen whom he learned the martial arts philosophy from and his journey of growing next-generation action stars; also give us an insight into the challenges towards Hong Kong action film nowadays.

programme.title: Eastern Condors / 東方禿鷹
programme.desc: “Eastern Condors” was the top secret mission of Department of Defense in the United States in 1987. The mission was to destroy the munitions left over in Vietnam during the Vietnam War. Since it was the top secret mission, Lieutenant Lam could only select Chinese felons from the Federal prison lured by the right of residence and big money to execute the mission. As the irregular troop, they just had informal training before they went to Vietnam. During the mission, they had to pass over mountains and challenge their own wills. They started with no trust to become mutually supportive with one another at the end. However, only few of them were able to come back eventually.

programme.title: Fury / 情義心
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taiwan. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky...

programme.title: Project A / A計劃
programme.desc: This is Hong Kong at the turn of the century. The South China Sea is crawling with smugglers, cut-throats and pirates and none is more successful than the gang led by the notorious pirate Lo. Government forces invariably lose to Lo. Finally the Government looks the other way whenever Lo is around. Young seaman Jackie Chan, so far better known for his bar room fights, resigns from the Marine Force. He plans to stage a personal vendetta against Lo. Jackie gets the help of Samo Hung, little knowing Samo has his own axe to grind. Jackie and Samo suffer an inglorious drubbing in the hands of Lo. Jackie, now completely incensed, decides to don the uniform once again. He finds young commander Yuen Biao sympathetic to his cause but adamant against his antics...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Peter Lai / 影人映語 -詞「得」達意 - 黎彼得
programme.desc: Although a lot of people recognize Peter Lai mostly from his TV drama's performance, he is arguably one of the veteran lyricists in Hong Kong music industry. Looking back from ‘Choi San Dou' to ‘Monica', his lyrics have definitely contributed the success of numerous well-known immortals. Why would he become an actor while debuted as a lyricist? Worked with so many famous stars, what related interesting stories he is going to reveal to us?

programme.title: Royal Warriors / 皇家戰士
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China and America / 黃飛鴻之西域雄獅
programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Lee Lai Chun / 影人映語 -李麗珍
programme.desc: Lee Lai Chun, a cinema goddess in the 1980s and 90s, has made her appearances in numerous Hong Kong movies. She seems to be a productive actress; but she admits that comparing to Carol ‘Dodo' Cheng or Sandra Ng who both has simultaneously worked on 9 film sets, doing 3 films at the same time for her is already exhausting enough. When she talks about the mode of filmmaking then and now, she misses and cherishes her family bonding with Tung Piu and Lydia Shum on the sets of the classic Lunar-New-Year series IT'S A MAD MAD MAD WORLD. Being in the film industry for over 30 years, though she has been awarded the Golden Horse Best Leading Actress, she regretfully says that she has not seen the birth of her own iconic role. Then, what does her ideal representative work looks like?

programme.title: For Your Heart Only / 為你鍾情
programme.desc: Disc jockey Piggy Chan, mechanic Sapi and cousin Hayden are good friends. Three of them form a trio - LOVEBURSTERS. Piggy falls in love at first sight with Jane Yu. He tears down all obstacles to win her heart. With the victory, he resumes his inclination to flirt around. His friends and relatives are very upset to see him deserting Jane...

programme.title: The Banquet / 豪門夜宴
programme.desc: “The Banquet” assembled star-studded cast that aimed for charity to support disaster relief efforts at that time. Adapted from the 1959 Cantonese film of the same name and co-directed by Tsui Hark, Clifton Ko, Joe Cheung, and Alfred Cheung, the film tells the story of a greedy couple deceiving their estranged father to secure a huge amount business deal with oil producing country. While they pretend to welcome the father into their home and prepare a birthday banquet for him, rival also throws a competing banquet...With continuous top-star cameos offering countless surprises and laughs, this film remains remarkable, entertaining and meaningful to audience nowadays.

programme.title: Anna Magdalena / 安娜瑪德蓮娜
programme.desc: A romantic tale about 3 young people who starts out as adversaries and blossoms into something else. When a gorgeous female moves into the building and 2 men fall in love with her.

programme.title: The Hand Of Death / 少林門
programme.desc: The Shaolin Temple is the center of Chinese martial arts and the cradle of anti-Manchu patriots in the 17th century. However, a Shaolin renegade Shih has defected to the Manchu and is leading a suppression of patriots trying to overthrow the Qing Dynasty. Tan Hsiung, a patriot, is arrested and killed by Shih. The Shaolin Abbot thus calls on his best student, Yun Fei to stop Shih from killing more people. Yun happens to find help from another anti-Manchu patriot, Tan, who is actually Tan Hsiung's younger brother. Along with help of Zorro, a master swordsman...

programme.title: Keep On Dancing / 繼續跳舞
programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over...

programme.title: 90’s Hotties Collection: Doctor Vampire / 90‘s女神駕到！: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May...

programme.title: He Lives By Night / 夜驚魂
programme.desc: A cuckolded husband becomes a cross-dressing night stalker, compelled to strike down any women he sees wearing white fish-net stockings. Leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake, he selects a female disc jockey as his next target...

programme.title: Fury / 情義心
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taiwan. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky...

programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.

programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy...

She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over...

programme.title: Project A Part II / A 計劃續集
programme.desc: A group of Chinese revolutionaries are being bunted by agents of the Dowager Empress, and Jackie has to use all his courage, wits and physical prowess to keep the peace...

programme.title: The Seventh Curse / 原振俠與衛斯理
programme.desc: Yuan Chen-ha saves Betsy from being sacrificed by the wicked priest in Thailand, but is stricken with seven blood curses. Soon, Yuan's veins start to burst, Wesley sends Yuan, Rainbow and Betsy's boy-friend back to find Buddha's Eye, which can cure Yuan. The wicked priest has directed the blood demon to attack Yuan and his friends. Wesley comes up with the weapons to destroy their wicked enemies...

programme.title: Hitman / 殺手之王
programme.desc: With a box of worthless war bonds, an old man hired the King of Killers to assassinate a Japanese trade lord. In WWII, the trade lord's action had caused grave damage to the family of the King of Killers. He agrees to take the job and delivers in a few days. The Revenge Fund set up by the trade lord kicks in. Whoever avenges the trade lord's death, killing the killer and the force behind him, will receive a reward of $1 billion. The police assigns Inspector to watch the killers, with orders to leave them room when they kill each other. Among the killers vying for the reward are Fu, a new immigrant, and his agent, Wong a longtime loser trying to score a big one riding on Fu's coat-tail. After an elaborately orchestrated chain of events, Wong and Fu manage to accomplish their goal.

programme.title: A Chinese Ghost Story III / 道道道
programme.desc: One stormy night, a wise High Priest and his student, Fong, pass by the Orchid Temple and realize it is haunted. Here, Fong encounters two lady demons, the seductive Lotus and her hated sister, Butterfly. Although Fong knows his Master wants to capture these evil spirits, he finds himself attracted to the Ghost and allows them to go free. The monks' stay at the Temple is prolonged due to Fong carelessly misplacing their valuable Taolisman, the Gold Suddna. During a trip to the corrupt local town, the High Priest meets Yin by chance and a series of misunderstandings evolve...

programme.title: Happy Ghost IV / 開心鬼救開心鬼
programme.desc: Hong Sum Kwai is enjoying a second life in metropolis Hong Kong. His girlfriend, Annie, is oblivious to the fact that her former incarnation was the village girl who perished the General to eternal suffering. Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. There are four sprightly yet mischievous male students in Hong Sum Kwai's charge, but they are duped by the girls and left stranded in the wilderness discovering the dead body of the General...

programme.title: Love is Love / 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage...

programme.title: Wu Yen / 鍾無艷
programme.desc: On his hunting trip, Emperor Qi takes a wrong turn and is confronted by bandit leader/wild beauty Wu Yen. The two are immediately attracted to each other. However, an ugly mole on Wu Yen's face thwarts this match made in heaven. Emperor Qi cancels the wedding for fear of marrying someone ugly. The mole is the result of a 'love spell' put by enchantress Yin Chun, who is actually an incarnation of a 3000-years old fox with great magical power...

programme.title: Daddy, Father And Papa / 老豆唔怕多
programme.desc: As with any other child of his age, seven-years-old Benny takes delight in getting into mischief and is a constant headache to his teachers and classmates. One day, his naughty ways finally led him into serious trouble. A list of triad members has fallen into his hands and he was kidnapped by the notorious gangsters. Thinking it was one of his usual pranks, his dad was undisturbed by Benny's sudden disappearance and made no attempt to trace his whereabouts. However, providence is on Benny's side for a policeman and a reporter are hot pursuit of him, as they both believed Benny to be their son...

programme.title: 90’s Hotties Collection: Perfect Exchange / 90‘s女神駕到！: 至尊三十六計之偷天換日
programme.desc: Mindy is a top-notched gambler. During a card game, Mindy swindles millions of dollars, but he is caught. Lau makes a deal with Mindy that Mindy needs to go to prison...

programme.title: Hocus Pocus / 人嚇鬼
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence...

programme.title: The Seventh Curse / 原振俠與衛斯理
programme.desc: Yuan Chen-ha saves Betsy from being sacrificed by the wicked priest in Thailand, but is stricken with seven blood curses. Soon, Yuan's veins start to burst, Wesley sends Yuan, Rainbow and Betsy's boy-friend back to find Buddha's Eye, which can cure Yuan. The wicked priest has directed the blood demon to attack Yuan and his friends. Wesley comes up with the weapons to destroy their wicked enemies...

programme.title: Righting Wrongs / 執法先鋒
programme.desc: Ha Ling Ching, a mild-mannered prosecutor who takes the law into his own hands, when the legal system fails to capture the most notorious criminals. As the police assign a tough, gutsy inspector Cindy to stop Ha's vigilante hunting out of court, another murder brings them together in the search for the real killer, who may or may not be one of their own!

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Fully Funny - Eric Kot / 影人映語 -葛來FUN多 - 葛民輝
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.title: Hitman / 殺手之王
programme.desc: With a box of worthless war bonds, an old man hired the King of Killers to assassinate a Japanese trade lord. In WWII, the trade lord's action had caused grave damage to the family of the King of Killers. He agrees to take the job and delivers in a few days. The Revenge Fund set up by the trade lord kicks in. Whoever avenges the trade lord's death, killing the killer and the force behind him, will receive a reward of $1 billion. The police assigns Inspector to watch the killers, with orders to leave them room when they kill each other. Among the killers vying for the reward are Fu, a new immigrant, and his agent, Wong a longtime loser trying to score a big one riding on Fu's coat-tail. After an elaborately orchestrated chain of events, Wong and Fu manage to accomplish their goal.

programme.title: Tiger Cage III / 冷面狙擊手
programme.desc: James and John are working in the Commercial Crime Bureau. Jointly they look into a case of which the suspect is an influential rich business man called Lee. James has a girl friend called Suki who is working for Wong, Lee's accountant. One night, in a party holding by Lee, John hears by chance the internal tips on a stock that Lee and his staff are talking about. John thus takes out all his saving and buys that stock. In the meantime, since Wong is murdered and James is also assaulted and seriously burnt, the case is closed under great pressure. On the other hand, the price of the stock which John has invested heavily slides. John is thus deeply depressed. Six months later, James has been much recovered under the care of two old men. At this time, Suki has climbed up to be a senior and important person in Wong's firm. Even Lee becomes a blocking stone in her eyes...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels / 情聖
programme.desc: Shing and Betty want to find money to pay back the loan shark. They break into a house and prepare to steal the valuable items in it. Old Bill, who also owes debts to the loan shark, happens to be in the house. He pretends to be the owner, because he thinks Shing is a wealthy man that he could cheat him for money. Eventually, they find out each other's real identity and cooperate to set plans and trap the loan shark.

programme.title: Mr Fortune / 發達先生
programme.desc: Toy designer Yau is always bullied by boss and ex-girlfriend. One day, Yau runs into a beautiful but rebellious girl named Ching, who tells him she is the target of triad harassment. Yau is determined to help her, and he resigns from his job at the encouragement of Ching. The two take low-pay jobs at a fast-food chain, and gradually fall in love with each other, but their relationship is threatened when Ching's true identity as the daughter of a tycoon is exposed...

programme.title: From Riches To Rags / 錢作怪
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Sammo Hung (Part 1) / 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶 (上)
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.title: Hocus Pocus / 人嚇鬼
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence...

programme.title: Parking Service / 代客泊車
programme.desc: Stanley was an optimistic youth, feeling bored in his pig-rearing job, he decided to part with his beloved uncle and aunt and seek for an ideal job to achieve his own goal in life. He then found a job in Tsim Sha Tsui East. There he worked as a member of a parking service team and befriended one of his colleagues Ah Man. Ah Man was a reticent guy who was always frustrated by reality. The problem that he could not afford his sister to further studies in oversea puzzled him now and then. His anxiety was intensified by his sorrowful devotion to a mysterious beautiful girl Stella. Stanley was enthusiastic to help Ah Man to be acquainted with Stella. This made Ah Man live in high spirits. Stanley also encouraged his colleagues to work with enthusiasm. Their team was therefore rewarded with more tips by customers. A member of another team was a man of misconduct who stole spare parts and valuables from customer's cars. Mr. Yang, was a man who made fake banknotes...

programme.title: The Royal Scoundrel / 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the Taiwanese group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk...

programme.title: Plain Jane To The Rescue / 八彩林亞珍
programme.desc: Jenny, with the plain looks but a heart of gold, she is always in between jobs. Once she gets a job, her knack of creating awkward situations immediately loses it for her. Fang is her suitor, but he gets nowhere as the girl has no time for love, so Fang goes along with her in job hunting. A big group called Sanda wants to take over the whole city through take-over deals. They are ruthless and have thrown thousands into the streets. Jenny and Fang, bungling as they are, become the vanguard of a movement against the great conglomerate. They were even being hunted by the group and their life was threatened...

programme.title: Armageddon / 天地雄心
programme.desc: As Ken (Andy Lau), one of the surviving scientists, tries to solve the unsolvable, he is haunted by the reappearance of his dead finace Adele (Michelle Reis).

programme.title: 90’s Hotties Collection: 3 Days Of A Blind Girl / 90‘s女神駕到！: 盲女七十二小時
programme.desc: Heung is temporarily blinded by an accident. While her doctor husband leaves Hong Kong for a meeting, an uninvited man arrives at their house. The man teases and tortures Heung, claiming that he is coming to avenge his wife...

programme.title: A True Mob Story / 龍在江湖
programme.desc: Cheung Dee, together with his best friends Long Life Chuen and Holy Sand, set up a valet parking counter outside a restaurant owned by a triad society he affiliates with. By accident, Cheung finds out that the son of his triad head, Tai Tze, is fiercely attacked by Song Bo. To save Tai's life, Cheung attacks Song and not only leaves a scar on Song's face, but also puts him in jail for five years which plants a seed of the revenge five years later. Form that moment, the only person that can cheer him up is his best girl friend Ruby. Yet, Cheung has his heart on Sandy, a young solicitor who helped set him free in an assault case. No sooner has their love relationship developed than Cheung's nightmare has begun......

programme.title: Thou Shall Not Commit / 逆天者
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Feng was an orphan. When he went on a date with a writer Zhi, Zhi died unexpectedly. After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels / 情聖
programme.desc: Shing and Betty want to find money to pay back the loan shark. They break into a house and prepare to steal the valuable items in it. Old Bill, who also owes debts to the loan shark, happens to be in the house. He pretends to be the owner, because he thinks Shing is a wealthy man that he could cheat him for money. Eventually, they find out each other's real identity and cooperate to set plans and trap the loan shark.

programme.title: The Big Brother / 一哥
programme.desc: Scriptwriter See is a confirmed bachelor. Wai is his devoted butler. Next door is no-good police Ko and his complaining wife Kit. Kit is beautiful and vain. Ko learns Kit's romance with Kar. He asks See for help. But Kar defeats their every move...

programme.title: Lavender / 薰衣草
programme.desc: Athena is an aromatherapy tutor but can't heal up her wound at heart. One day, she finds a broken-wing angel falling on balcony. A scented romance is gradually in between them...

programme.title: Love For All Seasons / 百年好合
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May. The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost 'Heartbreak Sword Technique'...

programme.desc: 20 years ago, in the region of Golden Triangle, Wah(aged about 9) and his parents, his god father (Keung) with his daughter (aged about 5) planned to smuggle some valuable items and information into Thailand. Wah's father, Keung and Leung were the closest of friends, just like blood brothers, all 3 of them were C.I.A. agents. Keung left for Thailand before the others to plan the operation. Leung ganged up with some bandits and forced Wah's father to surrender the confidential information. Wah, hidden in the dark, saw his parents being killed. 20 years later, Wah became an officer in the Thai Air Force. He couldn't take his mind off the revenge. Leung became a successful business man. He was in Thailand to launch a major business project. Ignoring Keung's advise, Wah and Roy slipped into Leung's hotel to try to assassinate him...

Tong is shaken at Chau's beauty. He decides to go after her. But Chau's master Mrs. Wah is very angry with Tong's family, how can Tong make Chau Heung his bride?

With two more accomplices, the four girls decide to destroy the body and split the $40 million the man has on him. But his gangs catch up with the girls and are about to rape and then kill them...

These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger...

programme.title: 90’s Hotties Collection: God of Gambler's Return / 90‘s女神駕到！: 賭神 2
programme.desc: Five years have passed since the events of the first God of Gamblers film. Ko Chun is now living a peaceful retirement on his French estate with his pregnant wife Wan Yau, while his disciples Knife and Sing have become world-renowned in their own right. Chun declines repeated challenges from other top-ranked gamblers, having given up gambling in favor of the quiet life. Chun's friend and former bodyguard, Lung Wu, the 'God Of Guns', comes to pay him a visit. While the two are away from the house for a friendly shooting competition, Chau Siu-Chee, a gambler and the world's number one contender to Ko Chun's title, arrives and murders his wife and unborn son in order to goad Chun into a gambling match. After a shootout with Chau Siu-Chee's henchmen, Ko Chun arrives to discover his wife dying. With her last breath, she asks Chun to promise that he will not gamble or admit his real identity for one year, in the hopes that he will not lose his life in an impulsive act of revenge. C

programme.title: Second Time Around / 無限復活

Ren and Sing begin their trip back to LA, but on the way their car mysteriously overturns and crashes, Sing is dead. Ren arrives home wearily to find a message on his answering machine that warns him not to go to Vegas. He decides to go back to Vegas to find out what really happened that killed Sing...

programme.desc: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S3E3 -Costa Rica: Sky to Sea / 迷忘國度 第3集 - 哥斯達黎加：海天之間
programme.desc: Visit the Monteverde cloud forest, where swirling mists feed Costa Rica’s mighty rivers and create a haven for biodiversity. See some of its 750 tree species, hang out with sloths and monkeys, and watch nature heal after decades of deforestation.

programme.desc: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E2 -A Close Encounter / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第2集 - 親密接觸
programme.desc: Feel the heat as rising temps mean that water is getting scarce. The Manzi pack must stand alongside predators to hydrate at a remaining precious water spot. Hunt with Weka’s pack to feed the pups, and watch the Stork Colony thrive against all odds.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E2 -Gardens in the Clouds / 非洲隱世國度 第2集 - 雲中花園
programme.desc: The plants and animals of the Cloud Mountains have long captured our imagination. In a landscape defined by weather and threatened by invaders, see how indigenous forests survive by providing a sanctuary for life while opening a door to the past.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E1 -Snares Islands/ Tini Heke / 深藍巨獸 第1集 - 斯奈爾斯群島（毛利語：Tini Heke）
programme.desc: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E2 -Otago Peninsula/ Muaupoko / 深藍巨獸 第2集 - 奧塔哥半島 (毛利語：Muaupoko)
programme.desc: Set sail for New Zealand’s Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E3 -Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu / 深藍巨獸 第3集 - 南方之巔 (毛利語：Te Tau Ihu)
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand’s South Island, where one of the world’s longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E4 -The Hauraki Gulf/ Te Moananui a Toi / 深藍巨獸 第4集 - 豪拉基灣
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures. Catch a glimpse of a stealthy manta ray, enjoy dolphin antics, and admire a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E5 -Three Kings Islands/ Manawatāwhi / 深藍巨獸 第5集 - 三王群島
programme.desc: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E6 -Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani / 深藍巨獸 第6集 - 科克群島
programme.desc: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands’ massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E1 -A Summer to Remember / 野生動物急診室 第1集 - 難忘的夏季
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E2 -A Prickly Problem / 野生動物急診室 第2集 - 一個棘手難題
programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koala’s spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelle’s slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E3 -Nobody Likes Visiting the Dentist / 野生動物急診室 第3集 - 諱疾忌牙醫
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree’s clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E4 -Platypus Predicament / 野生動物急診室 第4集 - 鴨嘴獸的困境
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E5 -Turtle Trouble / 野生動物急診室 第5集 - 烏龜的麻煩
programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive S1E1 -Trapped at Low Tide / 13小時生還記 第1集 - 潮池困局
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive S1E2 -Escape to the Deep / 13小時生還記 第2集 - 逃向深海
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance / 月球野性面 第2集 - 月光情緣
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E1 -Desert-Adapted Elephant / 野獸絕地求生記 第1集 - 沙漠中的大象
programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E2 -Saltwater Crocodile / 野獸絕地求生記 第2集 - 灣鱷
programme.desc: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E3 -Orangutan / 野獸絕地求生記 第3集 - 紅毛猩猩
programme.desc: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungle’s master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primate’s natural engineering prowess.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E3 -Stork Pack in Trouble / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第3集 - 陷入困境的鸛群
programme.desc: Agonize over a lost Stork pack puppy, and tussle with Manzi pups who are sorting their place in the hierarchy, figuring out noisy-neighbor friends and foes. Hop on a search mission with Julz for the missing Kakuli pack in the desolate Badlands.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E3 -The Sandveld: Land of Contrasts / 非洲隱世國度 第3集 - 珊德維爾德：反差之地
programme.desc: A narrow and harsh belt of western coastline in southern Africa is a land of contrasts where creatures are forced to adapt to survive. Meet the quirky and charismatic inhabitants that call this fragile interplay between land and ocean home.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E1 -Leaping Into Life / 農場野生物語 第1集 - 生命誕生
programme.desc: It’s spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E2 -Great Escape / 農場野生物語 第2集 - 大逃亡
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E3 -Change in the Air / 農場野生物語 第3集 - 季節更迭
programme.desc: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E4 -Hunkering Down / 農場野生物語 第4集 - 長期抗戰
programme.desc: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumn’s final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

programme.title: Deep in the Heart / 深入內地
programme.desc: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State’s landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas’ unique habitats.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide / 潮游國度
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E1 -The Journey Begins / 野性湄公河 第1集 - 旅程的開始
programme.desc: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of China’s land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E2 -Laos: the Mountain Wilds / 野性湄公河 第2集 - 老撾：山地荒野
programme.desc: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E3 -Thailand: Coming of Age / 野性湄公河 第3集 - 泰國：發展壯大
programme.desc: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekong’s banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the region’s abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E4 -The Karst Caves / 野性湄公河 第4集 - 寮國：喀斯特地形
programme.desc: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E5 -Nature's Crossroads / 野性湄公河 第5集 - 大自然的十字路口
programme.desc: As the Mekong River travels down Thailand’s eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Coral City S1E1 -Spring / 珊瑚之城 第1集 - 春天
programme.desc: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reef’s main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

programme.title: Coral City S1E2 -Summer / 珊瑚之城 第2集 - 夏天
programme.desc: Feel the heat of summer’s arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

programme.title: Coral City S1E3 -Autumn / 珊瑚之城 第3集 - 秋天
programme.desc: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

programme.title: Coral City S1E4 -Winter / 珊瑚之城 第4集 - 寒冬
programme.desc: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eel’s talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E1 -Bound By Blood / 南荒之地 第1集 - 綑綁遊戲
programme.desc: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealand’s South Island. Face forest penguins’ feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E2 -Life in Dark Water / 南荒之地 第2集 - 黑水作業
programme.desc: Learn how winter’s arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E3 -Age of Independence / 南荒之地 第3集 - 獨立紀元
programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of society, or strike out on their own adventures.
