programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E4 -Big Cats, Big Trouble / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第4集 - 大貓大麻煩
programme.desc: Dodge a leopard with the Manzi dogs while they treat themselves to a stolen feast. No such luck for the Kakuli pack on the hunt, as they’re foiled by a brave puku antelope. Find the stork pack, and retreat from charging elephants with Jules and Simon.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E1 -First Steps / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第1集 - 初踏之路
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long’uro and see why six-year-old Kelele’s mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E2 -Back to the Wild / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第2集 - 重返野外
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E3 -The Misfit Comes of Age / 非洲獵人 第3集 - 不合群的成年禮
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E4 -The Leopard Who Changed Her Spots / 非洲獵人 第4集 - 斑點幻變的豹
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E6 -End of Summer / 野生動物急診室 第6集 - 夏日終結
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E6 -Thailand: the River Basin / 野性湄公河 第6集 - 泰國：江河流域
programme.desc: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the region’s delicate living networks.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E5 -The Lost Boy / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第5集 - 丟失的小獸
programme.desc: Film a wild dog hunt with Julz as he catches up with the Manzi pack at a kill, and watch for leopards and hyenas as the Kakuli pack takes great risks while waiting for the rains to come. Go on an epic hunt with a returning male of the Stork Colony.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E3 -The Misfit Comes of Age / 非洲獵人 第3集 - 不合群的成年禮

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E4 -Defenders of the Reef / 阿拉伯海 第4集 - 礁石上的保衛兵
programme.desc: It’s summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E5 -A Turtle's Legacy / 阿拉伯海 第5集 - 海龜的遺產
programme.desc: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E1 -The Little Penguin / 澳洲野鳥 第1集 - 小藍企鵝

programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa’s most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E3 -The Partners / 狗建奇工 第3集 - 搭檔
programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher’s pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E3 -Orangutan / 野獸絕地求生記 第3集 - 紅毛猩猩
programme.desc: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungle’s master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primate’s natural engineering prowess.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E1 -First Steps / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第1集 - 初踏之路
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long’uro and see why six-year-old Kelele’s mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E2 -Back to the Wild / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第2集 - 重返野外
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E4 -The Feathering Nest / 澳洲野鳥 第4集 - 鳥巢
programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Wherever they live, these birds have got their work cut out, holding their territory against invaders, attracting and winning partners and safeguarding their chicks.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E10 -Vietnam: the Journey's End / 野性湄公河 第10集 - 越南：旅途的終點
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of society, or strike out on their own adventures.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E4 -The Karst Caves / 野性湄公河 第4集 - 寮國：喀斯特地形
programme.desc: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

programme.title: Undiscovered Vistas S3E3 -Costa Rica: Sky to Sea / 迷忘國度 第3集 - 哥斯達黎加：海天之間
programme.desc: Visit the Monteverde cloud forest, where swirling mists feed Costa Rica’s mighty rivers and create a haven for biodiversity. See some of its 750 tree species, hang out with sloths and monkeys, and watch nature heal after decades of deforestation.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons S1E1 -Spring / 美國在野四季錄 第1集 - 春
programme.desc: It’s spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests S1E5 -Boreal / 仙境森林的秘密 第5集 - 北方
programme.desc: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue S1E3 -One Very Lost Sea Turtle / 捍衞太平洋 第3集 - 迷途龜洋
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E1 -The Rescuers / 狗建奇工 第1集 - 拯救者們
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble—both on land and in the water.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E1 -Meet the Packs / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第1集 - 初见族群
programme.desc: Connect with the three packs: the large Manzi pack in the lush heartland, the Kakuli pack in the Badlands, and the tiny Stork Colony pack living at the park’s edge. Follow Julz as he shares their victories and defeats in this make-or-break season.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue S1E3 -One Very Lost Sea Turtle / 捍衞太平洋 第3集 - 迷途龜洋
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Alien Abyss S1E3 -The Next Generation / 深淵異形 第3集 - 下世代
programme.desc: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the ocean’s most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

programme.title: Stormborn S1E3 -Children of the Storm / 風暴之子 第3集 - 冰雪之子
programme.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

programme.title: Weird, Wild & Wonderful / 怪．野．美
programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E5 -Turtle Trouble / 野生動物急診室 第5集 - 烏龜的麻煩
programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E5 -Nature's Crossroads / 野性湄公河 第5集 - 大自然的十字路口
programme.desc: As the Mekong River travels down Thailand’s eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E2 -A Close Encounter / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第2集 - 親密接觸
programme.desc: Feel the heat as rising temps mean that water is getting scarce. The Manzi pack must stand alongside predators to hydrate at a remaining precious water spot. Hunt with Weka’s pack to feed the pups, and watch the Stork Colony thrive against all odds.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E2 -Gardens in the Clouds / 非洲隱世國度 第2集 - 雲中花園
programme.desc: The plants and animals of the Cloud Mountains have long captured our imagination. In a landscape defined by weather and threatened by invaders, see how indigenous forests survive by providing a sanctuary for life while opening a door to the past.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E1 -Snares Islands/ Tini Heke / 深藍巨獸 第1集 - 斯奈爾斯群島（毛利語：Tini Heke）
programme.desc: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E2 -Otago Peninsula/ Muaupoko / 深藍巨獸 第2集 - 奧塔哥半島 (毛利語：Muaupoko)
programme.desc: Set sail for New Zealand’s Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E3 -Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu / 深藍巨獸 第3集 - 南方之巔 (毛利語：Te Tau Ihu)
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand’s South Island, where one of the world’s longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E4 -The Hauraki Gulf/ Te Moananui a Toi / 深藍巨獸 第4集 - 豪拉基灣
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures. Catch a glimpse of a stealthy manta ray, enjoy dolphin antics, and admire a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E5 -Three Kings Islands/ Manawatāwhi / 深藍巨獸 第5集 - 三王群島
programme.desc: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue S1E6 -Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani / 深藍巨獸 第6集 - 科克群島
programme.desc: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands’ massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E1 -A Summer to Remember / 野生動物急診室 第1集 - 難忘的夏季
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E2 -A Prickly Problem / 野生動物急診室 第2集 - 一個棘手難題
programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koala’s spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelle’s slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E3 -Nobody Likes Visiting the Dentist / 野生動物急診室 第3集 - 諱疾忌牙醫
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree’s clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E4 -Platypus Predicament / 野生動物急診室 第4集 - 鴨嘴獸的困境
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E5 -Turtle Trouble / 野生動物急診室 第5集 - 烏龜的麻煩
programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive S1E1 -Trapped at Low Tide / 13小時生還記 第1集 - 潮池困局
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive S1E2 -Escape to the Deep / 13小時生還記 第2集 - 逃向深海
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance / 月球野性面 第2集 - 月光情緣
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E1 -Desert-Adapted Elephant / 野獸絕地求生記 第1集 - 沙漠中的大象
programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E2 -Saltwater Crocodile / 野獸絕地求生記 第2集 - 灣鱷
programme.desc: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E3 -Orangutan / 野獸絕地求生記 第3集 - 紅毛猩猩
programme.desc: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungle’s master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primate’s natural engineering prowess.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive S1E1 -Trapped at Low Tide / 13小時生還記 第1集 - 潮池困局
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive S1E2 -Escape to the Deep / 13小時生還記 第2集 - 逃向深海
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance / 月球野性面 第2集 - 月光情緣
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E1 -Desert-Adapted Elephant / 野獸絕地求生記 第1集 - 沙漠中的大象
programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E2 -Saltwater Crocodile / 野獸絕地求生記 第2集 - 灣鱷
programme.desc: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E3 -Orangutan / 野獸絕地求生記 第3集 - 紅毛猩猩
programme.desc: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungle’s master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primate’s natural engineering prowess.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E3 -Stork Pack in Trouble / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第3集 - 陷入困境的鸛群
programme.desc: Agonize over a lost Stork pack puppy, and tussle with Manzi pups who are sorting their place in the hierarchy, figuring out noisy-neighbor friends and foes. Hop on a search mission with Julz for the missing Kakuli pack in the desolate Badlands.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E3 -The Sandveld: Land of Contrasts / 非洲隱世國度 第3集 - 珊德維爾德：反差之地
programme.desc: A narrow and harsh belt of western coastline in southern Africa is a land of contrasts where creatures are forced to adapt to survive. Meet the quirky and charismatic inhabitants that call this fragile interplay between land and ocean home.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E1 -Leaping Into Life / 農場野生物語 第1集 - 生命誕生
programme.desc: It’s spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E2 -Great Escape / 農場野生物語 第2集 - 大逃亡
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E3 -Change in the Air / 農場野生物語 第3集 - 季節更迭
programme.desc: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm S1E4 -Hunkering Down / 農場野生物語 第4集 - 長期抗戰
programme.desc: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumn’s final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

programme.title: Deep in the Heart / 深入內地
programme.desc: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State’s landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas’ unique habitats.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide / 潮游國度
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E1 -The Journey Begins / 野性湄公河 第1集 - 旅程的開始
programme.desc: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of China’s land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E2 -Laos: the Mountain Wilds / 野性湄公河 第2集 - 老撾：山地荒野
programme.desc: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E3 -Thailand: Coming of Age / 野性湄公河 第3集 - 泰國：發展壯大
programme.desc: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekong’s banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the region’s abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E4 -The Karst Caves / 野性湄公河 第4集 - 寮國：喀斯特地形
programme.desc: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E5 -Nature's Crossroads / 野性湄公河 第5集 - 大自然的十字路口
programme.desc: As the Mekong River travels down Thailand’s eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Coral City S1E1 -Spring / 珊瑚之城 第1集 - 春天
programme.desc: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reef’s main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

programme.title: Coral City S1E2 -Summer / 珊瑚之城 第2集 - 夏天
programme.desc: Feel the heat of summer’s arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

programme.title: Coral City S1E3 -Autumn / 珊瑚之城 第3集 - 秋天
programme.desc: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

programme.title: Coral City S1E4 -Winter / 珊瑚之城 第4集 - 寒冬
programme.desc: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eel’s talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E1 -Bound By Blood / 南荒之地 第1集 - 綑綁遊戲
programme.desc: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealand’s South Island. Face forest penguins’ feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E2 -Life in Dark Water / 南荒之地 第2集 - 黑水作業
programme.desc: Learn how winter’s arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E3 -Age of Independence / 南荒之地 第3集 - 獨立紀元
programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of society, or strike out on their own adventures.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E4 -Big Cats, Big Trouble / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第4集 - 大貓大麻煩
programme.desc: Dodge a leopard with the Manzi dogs while they treat themselves to a stolen feast. No such luck for the Kakuli pack on the hunt, as they’re foiled by a brave puku antelope. Find the stork pack, and retreat from charging elephants with Jules and Simon.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E1 -First Steps / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第1集 - 初踏之路
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long’uro and see why six-year-old Kelele’s mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E2 -Back to the Wild / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第2集 - 重返野外
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E3 -The Misfit Comes of Age / 非洲獵人 第3集 - 不合群的成年禮
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E4 -The Leopard Who Changed Her Spots / 非洲獵人 第4集 - 斑點幻變的豹
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E6 -End of Summer / 野生動物急診室 第6集 - 夏日終結
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E6 -Thailand: the River Basin / 野性湄公河 第6集 - 泰國：江河流域
programme.desc: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the region’s delicate living networks.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack S1E5 -The Lost Boy / 野狗：與族群一起奔跑 第5集 - 丟失的小獸
programme.desc: Film a wild dog hunt with Julz as he catches up with the Manzi pack at a kill, and watch for leopards and hyenas as the Kakuli pack takes great risks while waiting for the rains to come. Go on an epic hunt with a returning male of the Stork Colony.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E4 -Defenders of the Reef / 阿拉伯海 第4集 - 礁石上的保衛兵
programme.desc: It’s summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E5 -A Turtle's Legacy / 阿拉伯海 第5集 - 海龜的遺產
programme.desc: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E1 -The Little Penguin / 澳洲野鳥 第1集 - 小藍企鵝
programme.desc: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E7 -Cambodia: Hidden Refuges / 野性湄公河 第7集 - 柬埔寨：隱秘的庇護所
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekong’s mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E7 -Cambodia: Hidden Refuges / 野性湄公河 第7集 - 柬埔寨：隱秘的庇護所
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekong’s mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E3 -The Misfit Comes of Age / 非洲獵人 第3集 - 不合群的成年禮
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E4 -The Leopard Who Changed Her Spots / 非洲獵人 第4集 - 斑點幻變的豹
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance / 月球野性面 第2集 - 月光情緣
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E4 -Defenders of the Reef / 阿拉伯海 第4集 - 礁石上的保衛兵
programme.desc: It’s summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

programme.title: Arabian Seas S1E5 -A Turtle's Legacy / 阿拉伯海 第5集 - 海龜的遺產
programme.desc: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

programme.desc: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

programme.desc: The Emu is Australia’s biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where females call the shots, eggs are green and men do all the work to produce and raise tiny babies, known as Stripeys.

programme.desc: The Mekong is Cambodia’s lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

programme.desc: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungle’s master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primate’s natural engineering prowess.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E1 -First Steps / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第1集 - 初踏之路
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long’uro and see why six-year-old Kelele’s mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E2 -Back to the Wild / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第2集 - 重返野外
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E4 -The Feathering Nest / 澳洲野鳥 第4集 - 鳥巢
programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Wherever they live, these birds have got their work cut out, holding their territory against invaders, attracting and winning partners and safeguarding their chicks.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E10 -Vietnam: the Journey's End / 野性湄公河 第10集 - 越南：旅途的終點
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E3 -The Partners / 狗建奇工 第3集 - 搭檔
programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher’s pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E3 -Age of Independence / 南荒之地 第3集 - 獨立紀元
programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of society, or strike out on their own adventures.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E1 -First Steps / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第1集 - 初踏之路
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long’uro and see why six-year-old Kelele’s mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E2 -Back to the Wild / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第2集 - 重返野外
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E4 -The Feathering Nest / 澳洲野鳥 第4集 - 鳥巢
programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Wherever they live, these birds have got their work cut out, holding their territory against invaders, attracting and winning partners and safeguarding their chicks.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E10 -Vietnam: the Journey's End / 野性湄公河 第10集 - 越南：旅途的終點
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: The Whale Whisperer S1E1 / The Whale Whisperer 第1集
programme.desc: This film follows the inspiring relationship between whale whisperer Vicki Neville and the humpback whales of Australia. These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before!

programme.title: Experience Australia S1E3 -Tropical North Queensland / Experience Australia 第3集 - Tropical North Queensland
programme.desc: Tropical North Queensland is a region of lush rainforests, stunning beaches and rich indigenous history. In this episode, we explore the best activities on offer in this remarkable place. Experience the magical coral gardens of the Great Barrier Reef, see the Daintree Rainforest come to life on a nocturnal tour, and witness some of the nation’s oldest rock paintings at Jarramali bush camp.

programme.title: Experience Australia S1E4 -Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory / Experience Australia 第4集 - Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory
programme.desc: In this installment, we highlight the top experiences available in Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. From the pristine waters of the Sapphire Coast to the snow-capped peaks of Mount Kosciuszko, there is so much to discover. Ride through the majestic Snowy Mountains on horseback, learn about the fascinating lifecycle of an oyster in Pambula and immerse yourself in an indigenous cultural tour in Australia’s capital city, Canberra.

programme.title: Danger Decoded S1E5 -Industrial Machines / Danger Decoded 第5集 - Industrial Machines
programme.desc: Powerful industrial machines offer immense strength but carry deadly risks for those who use them.

They also take to the woods at night in search of coyotes and other night stalkers and talk to some seasoned trappers to learn more about why they do what they do. Not for the faint of heart or weak of stomach.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E1 -Polar Bear / Extreme Animal Transport 第1集 - Polar Bear
programme.desc: Henry is no ordinary polar bear. Born at Sea World on the Gold Coast, Australia, it was planned from day one that he would eventually make the journey to the small-town of Cochrane in Ontario, Canada, where he can live like a wild polar bear. The town folk of Cochrane decided they wanted the polar bear as its mascot, so they built an amazing polar bear facility. But there was one problem, they didn’t have a polar bear. Back at Sea World, Queensland, Henry is now an adult and after months of crate training and logistical planning, departure day arrives. The first leg is to Sydney but with no plane equipped to carry a polar bear, the Australian military step in. He flies first-class with his keepers on a Hercules jet to Sydney. From Sydney to Hong Kong, then Hong Kong to Vancouver where the plane is delayed, and Henry has eaten all his food. There’s still a long way to go to Ontario and they need to feed this hungry polar bear. It’s 11pm and there’s a supermarket close to the

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E2 -Tigers (Circus Tigers) / Extreme Animal Transport 第2集 - Tigers (Circus Tigers)
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. It’s an epic journey with traffic delays on the outskirts

programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken by European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in the very interior of the country.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips S1E5 -Central Victoria / Great Aussie Road Trips 第5集 - Central Victoria

programme.title: River Hunters S1E6 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege / River Hunters 第6集 - Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.

programme.title: River Hunters S1E6 -Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege / River Hunters 第6集 - Barnard Castle -River Tees- Elizabethan Siege
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters at the edge of one of Britain’s greatest castles, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette - battle the forceful River Tees. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be searching for lost Tudor relics from a gruesome 16th siege at Barnard Castle and secrets of this ancient borderland. In the 1500s, this was where North battled South in a grizzly attempt to overthrow Queen Elizabeth I and claim the throne for Mary, Queen of Scots.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S2E3 -Great Berrier Reef / Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第3集 - Great Berrier Reef
programme.desc: Along the coastline, Zac and Darin take a deep dive into the coral reef restoration techniques supporting a vast underwater ecosystem.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S2E4 -Torres Strait / Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第4集 - Torres Strait
programme.desc: Zac and Darin test their cooking skills in Melbourne before heading to the Torres Strait Islands to understand the impact of rising sea levels.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled S1E5 -Western Australia: Driving in the Dusty Kimberly / Sara's Australia Unveiled 第5集 - Western Australia: Driving in the Dusty Kimberly
programme.desc: Sara drives to East Kimberley, soaking in the scenery of the Cockburn Range mountains. Sara is so inspired by the communal spirit at Home Valley Station that she contributes by hosting a pizza night - with a wood fire oven crocodile pizza.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled S1E6 -Western Australia: More Than Meets The Eye / Sara's Australia Unveiled 第6集 - Western Australia: More Than Meets The Eye
programme.desc: Sara goes to Yawuru conservation park to try and catch some mud crabs with cultural guide Bart, who is originally from Broome.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E1 -Polar Bear / Extreme Animal Transport 第1集 - Polar Bear
programme.desc: Henry is no ordinary polar bear. Born at Sea World on the Gold Coast, Australia, it was planned from day one that he would eventually make the journey to the small-town of Cochrane in Ontario, Canada, where he can live like a wild polar bear. The town folk of Cochrane decided they wanted the polar bear as its mascot, so they built an amazing polar bear facility. But there was one problem, they didn’t have a polar bear. Back at Sea World, Queensland, Henry is now an adult and after months of crate training and logistical planning, departure day arrives. The first leg is to Sydney but with no plane equipped to carry a polar bear, the Australian military step in. He flies first-class with his keepers on a Hercules jet to Sydney. From Sydney to Hong Kong, then Hong Kong to Vancouver where the plane is delayed, and Henry has eaten all his food. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E2 -Tigers (Circus Tigers) / Extreme Animal Transport 第2集 - Tigers (Circus Tigers)
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips S1E4 -Sturts Steps / Great Aussie Road Trips 第4集 - Sturts Steps
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken by European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in the very interior of the country.

programme.title: Experience Australia S1E3 -Tropical North Queensland / Experience Australia 第3集 - Tropical North Queensland
programme.desc: Tropical North Queensland is a region of lush rainforests, stunning beaches and rich indigenous history. In this episode, we explore the best activities on offer in this remarkable place. Experience the magical coral gardens of the Great Barrier Reef, see the Daintree Rainforest come to life on a nocturnal tour, and witness some of the nation’s oldest rock paintings at Jarramali bush camp.

programme.title: Experience Australia S1E4 -Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory / Experience Australia 第4集 - Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory
programme.desc: In this installment, we highlight the top experiences available in Southern New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. From the pristine waters of the Sapphire Coast to the snow-capped peaks of Mount Kosciuszko, there is so much to discover. Ride through the majestic Snowy Mountains on horseback, learn about the fascinating lifecycle of an oyster in Pambula and immerse yourself in an indigenous cultural tour in Australia’s capital city, Canberra.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here S2E6 -Sao Paolo / Don't Drive Here 第6集 - Sao Paolo
programme.desc: If you thought samba and soccer were what Sao Paulo was famous for, think again. It's also known as home to the worst traffic jams in the world!

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E5 -More Texas Swine / Dead Meat 第5集 - More Texas Swine
programme.desc: Texas has a feral pig problem. They can tear up a farmer's field faster than a herd of rototillers. Scott and Scott's son, Jake, head out at night to kill hogs that will be used to feed a church group in Brownsville.

programme.title: Dead Meat S6E6 -What's a Nilgai? / Dead Meat 第6集 - What's a Nilgai?
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S1E7 -Lima / Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第7集 - Lima
programme.desc: Bio-piracy threatens the most precious resource: Food. But scientists and farmers band together to protect the local plants and seeds. See how exporting agriculture threatens the economy and survival of the indigenous people.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron S1E8 -Iquitos / Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第8集 - Iquitos
programme.desc: While the Malibu fires rage towards Darin’s home, he and Zac are deep in the jungle and off the grid uncovering the mysteries of the most powerful and potent plants in the Amazon Rainforest.

programme.title: Danger Decoded S1E5 -Industrial Machines / Danger Decoded 第5集 - Industrial Machines
programme.desc: Powerful industrial machines offer immense strength but carry deadly risks for those who use them.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E3 -Lions Pt 1 / Extreme Animal Transport 第3集 - Lions Pt 1
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E4 -Lions Pt 2 / Extreme Animal Transport 第4集 - Lions Pt 2
programme.desc: Locked in a dark cell in an illegal zoo is an adult lion who became known as Ivan -Asen. He was rescued by animal welfare organization, Four Paws and has been rehabilitating in Sofia Zoo. programme.title: Experience Australia S1E5 -Queensland / Experience Australia 第5集 - Queensland
programme.desc: Known as ‘The Sunshine State,’ Queensland is a region of spectacular beauty and adventurous possibilities. In this episode, we highlight some of the standout activities available to visitors in this incredible state. Traverse the pristine wilderness of K’gari, the world’s largest sand island, witness the humpback whale migration from the sheltered waters of Platypus Bay, and come face to face with Australia’s cutest animals at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary.

programme.title: Experience Australia S1E6 -South Australia / Experience Australia 第6集 - South Australia
programme.desc: From the ancient mountains of the Flinders Ranges to the rocky shores of the Great Australian Bight, South Australia is a land brimming with culture, history and natural wonders. In this installment, we feature the premier experiences to be had in this wonderful destination. Step onto the vast salt flats of the Gawler Ranges, fish for wild salmon from the shimmering shores of the Eyre Peninsular, and experience an iconic train journey through the outback, onboard The Ghan.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls S2E4 -Kate Winslet / Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第4集 - Kate Winslet
programme.desc: Oscar-winning actress Kate Winslet and Bear Grylls tackle the Snowdonia Mountains in Wales as Kate discusses her upbringing and career.

programme.title: Danger Decoded S1E6 -Natural Disasters / Danger Decoded 第6集 - Natural Disasters
programme.desc: Nature’s fury strikes without warning from tsunamis and wildfires to devastating tornadoes.

programme.title: Feral S1E3 -Burmese Pythons / Feral 第3集 - Burmese Pythons
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: Feral S1E4 -Green Iguanas / Feral 第4集 - Green Iguanas
programme.desc: A once sought-after pet, the green iguanas escaped their terrariums in the 60's and found the Florida eco-system to be a much more hospitable environment to call home. Free to roam the canals, parks, and suburban neighborhoods, these pets-gone-feral have exploded in both size and population, causing hundreds of millions of dollars of damage a year in Florida. Urban hunter Michael Onega is doing his part to clean up the environment by removing as many iguanas as possible, limiting their population spread. The singular goal - to make sure the iguanas never establish a healthy breeding population in the Everglades. Yia joins Michael and his trusty Labrador Scout on Michael's mud boat, as they patrol the canals in Michael's backyard. The only thing better than Scout retrieving the fallen iguanas, are BBQed iguana and iguana tacos cooked up in Michael's backyard.

programme.desc: Known as ‘The Sunshine State,’ Queensland is a region of spectacular beauty and adventurous possibilities. In this episode, we highlight some of the standout activities available to visitors in this incredible state. Traverse the pristine wilderness of K’gari, the world’s largest sand island, witness the humpback whale migration from the sheltered waters of Platypus Bay, and come face to face with Australia’s cutest animals at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary.

In this installment, we feature the premier experiences to be had in this wonderful destination. programme.title: Feral S1E3 -Burmese Pythons / Feral 第3集 - Burmese Pythons
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: Feral S1E4 -Green Iguanas / Feral 第4集 - Green Iguanas
programme.desc: A once sought-after pet, the green iguanas escaped their terrariums in the 60's and found the Florida eco-system to be a much more hospitable environment to call home. Free to roam the canals, parks, and suburban neighborhoods, these pets-gone-feral have exploded in both size and population, causing hundreds of millions of dollars of damage a year in Florida. programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw S3E7 -Home Delivery / 料理面對面 第7集 - 外送到家
programme.desc: Ex-Mr Wong and Lotus chef Sam Young, and television presenter Julia Zemiro join Adam to make their home delivery inspired meals.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw S3E8 -Umami / 料理面對面 第8集 - 鮮味
programme.desc: Insight's Kumi Taguchi and Chase Kojima from Sokyo join Adam Liaw to cook dishes centered on umami tastes.

programme.title: Jason Tastes Asia S1E5 -Philippines - The Sugar Trail / 阿賢亞洲好食光 第5集 - 菲律賓: 甜蜜小徑
programme.desc: Jason begins his food adventure in the Philippines by exploring sweet local delicacies that have strong Chinese Filipino influences.

programme.title: Jason Tastes Asia S1E6 -Philippines - Home Cooked Food With Two Chinese Filipino Families / 阿賢亞洲好食光 第6集 - 華裔菲律賓家常菜
programme.desc: Chinese influences on Filipino food traces back to the 11th century with the interaction of trade,and is now deeply embedded in Philippine history,hearts and tastes.

programme.title: Maneet's Eats S1E5 -Pakoras And Saag Paneer / 莫妮的印度菜 第5集 - 香酥炸蔬菜與菠菜起司咖哩
programme.desc: Chef Maneet Chauhan shares two more favorite Indian recipes, starting with crispy spinach and onion Pakoras.

programme.title: Maneet's Eats S1E6 -Masala Omelet Sandwich And Parathas / 莫妮的印度菜 第6集 - 香料歐姆蛋三明治與印度酥餅
programme.desc: Chef Maneet Chauhan prepares a classic Indian breakfast, the Masala Omelet Sandwich, with traditional Indian spices and Amul cheese.

programme.title: A Sweet Taste Of Art S1E7 -Nyonya Desserts / 甜味藝術 第7集 - 娘惹甜點
programme.desc: Nyonya desserts are colorful and always a delight to everyone. In this episode, we learn about the differences in Nyonya desserts in Penang, Malacca, and Singapore.

programme.title: Makan On Wheels S1E10 / 開著餐車趴趴走 第10集
programme.desc: The trio arrives in Sekinchan, the 'Land of Rice and Fish', to savour local delicacies. They stop over at Teluk Intan to hear stories from the locals.

programme.title: Good Chef Bad Chef S14E11 / 料理黑白碰 第11集
programme.desc: Join Chef Adrian Richardson and nutritionist Zoe Bingley-Pullin as they bring their distinctive styles of cooking to the screen for a food showdown.

programme.title: Good Chef Bad Chef S14E12 / 料理黑白碰 第12集
programme.desc: Join Chef Adrian Richardson and nutritionist Zoe Bingley-Pullin as they bring their distinctive styles of cooking to the screen for a food showdown.

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Hong Kong Kitchen S1E4 -Chris Bavin / 彭永浩的香港廚房 第4集 - 克里斯巴溫
programme.desc: Jeremy teams up with his good mate and TV presenter Chris Bavin for a Hong Kong adventure.

programme.title: Beyond Bali: The World's Most Exotic Islands S1E7 -West Flores Mountains: Manggarai Culture And Cooking / 峇里之外: 印尼異國島嶼 第7集 - 弗洛雷斯島西部山區
programme.desc: High in the mountains of Flores, Lara Lee discovers ancestral food traditions, soul-stirring hospitality, and the delicious charm of slow food from bamboo feasts.

programme.title: Jason Tastes Asia S1E7 -Vietnam - Wrap And Roll / 阿賢亞洲好食光 第7集 - 越南: 又包又捲
programme.desc: Jason visits local street food and savors some of the country's tastiest rolls,including Goi Cuon (Vietnamese spring rolls) and Bo La Lot (wild betel leaf beef rolls).

programme.title: Jason Tastes Asia S1E8 -Philippines - Panciteria And Panaderia / 阿賢亞洲好食光 第8集 - 菲律賓: 麵店和糕餅店
programme.desc: Jason travels back in time to the Spanish colonial period of the Philippines, when the Chinese began settling in the country.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw S3E9 -Ginger / 料理面對面 第9集 - 薑
programme.desc: Canton Kitchen's Jason Chan and Nelly Robinson, owner of Nel Restaurant, join Adam Liaw in the kitchen to cook ginger-infused dishes.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw S3E10 -Colour / 料理面對面 第10集 - 繽紛色彩
programme.desc: Television presenter Julia Zemiro and Sam Young, ex-head chef of Mr Wong and Lotus, cook up some colorful dishes with Adam Liaw.

programme.title: A Taste Of Festival S1E6 -Wedding / 節慶風味 第6集 - 婚禮
programme.desc: Let's learn banquet dishes from various restaurants, such as Chrysanthemum Fish, Passion Fruit Salad Prawns and also Peranakan wedding customs and wedding cakes.

programme.desc: Award-winning chef and restaurateur Katie Button explores the stories and uses behind different delicious ingredients and shares her knowledge of cooking techniques.
